features.name: Sint-Willibrordkerk
features.opening: St Willibrord's Church, Utrecht, is a Roman Catholic church operated by the traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X (SSPX) and dedicated to Saint Willibrord.

facts.text: The interior decoration was not finished until 1891, fourteen years after the church opened.
facts.sourceQuote: The church was dedicated in 1877 by monsignor Schaepman, but the interior wasn't completed until 1891.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was dedicated in 1877 by monsignor Schaepman, but the interior wasn't completed until 1891.

features.name: Fort De Gagel
features.opening: Fort De Gagel is een fort in Utrecht.

facts.text: The fort was placed in defensive position during the Franco-Prussian War of 1870.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste keer bij de Frans-Duitse Oorlog in 1870.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first time during the Franco-Prussian War in 1870.

facts.text: A nearby work defended the Klopvaart flood canal with sluice works about 1.5 kilometers northeast.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werk ligt op ongeveer 1,5 kilometer ten noordoosten van het Fort aan de Klop en verdedigde verder onder meer het inundatiekanaal met sluiswerken van de Klopvaart.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The work is located about 1.5 kilometers northeast of the Fort on the Klop and further defended the flood canal with sluice works of the Klopvaart, among other things.

facts.text: Fort Ruigenhoek stands to its east as part of the New Holland Water Line's third construction phase.
facts.sourceQuote: Ten oosten van het fort ligt Fort Ruigenhoek dat in de derde bouwfase van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie is gerealiseerd
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: East of the fort lies Fort Ruigenhoek, which was realized in the third construction phase of the New Holland Water Line.

features.name: Alida de Vries
features.opening: De lijst van Stolpersteine in Utrecht (gemeente) geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in de gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht zijn…

facts.text: The first Stolperstein in Utrecht honored Josephina Joosten-Groen, not Alida de Vries.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Stolperstein die in de stad Utrecht geplaatst is, was voor Josephina Joosten-Groen, die vrijwillig met haar man meeging naar Westerbork.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Stolperstein placed in the city of Utrecht was for Josephina Joosten-Groen, who voluntarily went with her husband to Westerbork.

facts.text: Five stones were placed at the former Central Jewish Orphanage on Nieuwegracht on that same day.
facts.sourceQuote: Dezelfde dag plaatste Gunter Demnig vijf Stolpersteine voor het voormalige Centraal Israëlitisch Weeshuis aan de Nieuwegracht: een voor de ongeveer zeventig weeskinderen en hun tien verzorgers en vier voor de familie Themans, die ervoor koos bij de kinderen te blijven toen deze gedeporteerd werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the same day, Gunter Demnig placed five Stolpersteine in front of the former Central Jewish Orphanage on the Nieuwegracht: one for the approximately seventy orphans and their ten caregivers and four for the Themans family, who chose to stay with the children when they were deported.

facts.text: Four stones commemorate the Themans family who stayed with the orphans during deportation.
facts.sourceQuote: Dezelfde dag plaatste Gunter Demnig vijf Stolpersteine voor het voormalige Centraal Israëlitisch Weeshuis aan de Nieuwegracht: een voor de ongeveer zeventig weeskinderen en hun tien verzorgers en vier voor de familie Themans, die ervoor koos bij de kinderen te blijven toen deze gedeporteerd werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the same day, Gunter Demnig placed five Stolpersteine in front of the former Central Jewish Orphanage on the Nieuwegracht: one for the approximately seventy orphans and their ten caregivers and four for the Themans family, who chose to stay with the children when they were deported.

facts.text: By November 2025, the municipality of Utrecht held a total of 274 Stolpersteine.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2025 lagen in de gemeente Utrecht 274 Stolpersteine.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2025, there were 274 Stolpersteine in the municipality of Utrecht.

features.name: VVJ
features.opening: Voetbalvereniging Jaffa, ook bekend als VVJ, is een Nederlandse amateurvoetbalclub uit de stad Utrecht, opgericht in 1931.

facts.text: VVJ takes its name from the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa.
facts.sourceQuote: De club is genoemd naar de Utrechtse Machinefabriek Jaffa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The club is named after the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa.

features.name: Sint-Augustinuskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Augustinuskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht, aan het noordelijk gedeelte van de Oudegracht (nr. 69), gewijd aan…

facts.text: A vault fragment fell in 2016, forcing closure until a major restoration finished.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 werd het gebouw gesloten door de brandweer nadat een brokstuk uit het gewelf naar beneden was gekomen. Een grote restauratie volgde, waarbij de oorspronkelijke kleuren van het hoogaltaar werden teruggebracht en het fresco en het gewelf werden hersteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016, the building was closed by the fire brigade after a fragment from the vault had fallen down. A major restoration followed, during which the original colors of the high altar were restored and the fresco and vault were restored.

facts.text: The canal side features a temple front with enormous Doric columns topped by a pediment and a 40-meter tower.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze valt op door het tempelfront met de enorme dorische zuilen aan de grachtzijde, bekroond door een fronton en een luchtig torentje (het geheel 40 m hoog).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It stands out due to the temple front with the enormous Doric columns on the canal side, crowned by a pediment and a light tower (the whole 40 m high).

facts.text: Prosper Venneman from Ghent created the main altar in 1857.
facts.sourceQuote: Het hoofdaltaar werd in 1857 vervaardigd door Prosper Venneman uit Gent.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main altar was made in 1857 by Prosper Venneman from Ghent.

features.name: Walk of Fame
features.opening: De Walk of Fame in Utrecht bevindt zich in de Vinkenburgstraat in het centrum van Utrecht.

facts.text: The installation features bronze plaques bearing the hand and footprints of film celebrities.
facts.sourceQuote: De Walk of Fame bestaat uit bronzen plakkaten met hand en voetafdrukken van beroemdheden uit de filmwereld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Walk of Fame consists of bronze plaques with hand and footprints of celebrities from the film world.

features.name: Nieuwe Kerk
features.opening: De Nieuwe Kerk is een kerk in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: A nearby community hall named De Klopper hosted youth activities during the 1950s and 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de Nieuwe Kerk staat aan de ene kant het huis van de koster en aan de andere kant een poort waarachter een wijkgebouw zat (met de naam De Klopper). Daar werden in de jaren 50 en 60 activiteiten voor de jeugd georganiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the Nieuwe Kerk is on one side the house of the caretaker and on the other side a gate behind which there was a community building (named De Klopper). Activities for the youth were organized there in the 1950s and 1960s.

features.name: Weerdpoort
features.opening: De Weerdpoort, ook wel Amsterdamse Poort genoemd, was vanaf de middeleeuwen een van de vier stadspoorten van de stad Utrecht.

facts.text: The gate was demolished between 1845 and 1862 to make way for the Weerdbrug.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen circa 1845 en 1862 werd de Weerdpoort gesloopt en de Weerdbrug gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between approximately 1845 and 1862, the Weerdpoort was demolished and the Weerdbrug built.

facts.text: Trekschuit boats departed from outside this gate for Amsterdam during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 17e en 18e eeuw vertrok buiten de Weerdpoort de Trekschuit naar Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 17th and 18th centuries, the Trekschuit departed from outside the Weerdpoort for Amsterdam.

features.name: Gerardus Majellakerk
features.opening: De Gerardus Majellakerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk in Utrecht.

facts.text: Sculptor René van Seumeren created the wooden Mary altar installed in 1950.
facts.sourceQuote: Het houten Maria-altaar is van de hand van beeldhouwer René van Seumeren en werd geplaatst in 1950.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The wooden Mary altar was made by sculptor René van Seumeren and was placed in 1950.

facts.text: A generous donation by Frans van Seumeren funded the bell tower added in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was een bijzonder gebaar van Frans van Seumeren toen hij in 1954 een beiaard schonk aan de kerk die mede door zijn inzet en geldelijke steun gesticht was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was a particularly generous gesture from Frans van Seumeren when he donated a bell tower to the church founded in part through his efforts and financial support in 1954.

features.name: Hamtoren
features.opening: The Hamtoren is the remains of the historical Den Ham Castle in Vleuten.

facts.text: The tower survived a 12-week siege during the Utrecht war of 1481–83 before being plundered and partially destroyed.
facts.sourceQuote: Notably, the tower was besieged for 12 weeks in the Utrecht war of 1481–83, which resulted in its plundering and partial destruction.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Notably, the tower was besieged for 12 weeks in the Utrecht war of 1481–83, which resulted in its plundering and partial destruction.

facts.text: In 1536, the States of Utrecht officially recognized Den Ham as a knightly manor and admitted its residents to the Knighthood.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1536 the States of Utrecht recognized Den Ham as a ridderhofstad ("knightly manor") and admitted its residents to the Knighthood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1536 the States of Utrecht recognized Den Ham as a ridderhofstad ("knightly manor") and admitted its residents to the Knighthood.

facts.text: Musician Bas Kennis from the band Blof purchased the tower in 2016 with plans to convert it into a recording studio.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the tower was purchased by Bas Kennis, musician with Blof, with the intent of transforming it into a studio.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the tower was purchased by Bas Kennis, musician with Blof, with the intent of transforming it into a studio.

features.name: Werk aan de Hoofddijk
features.opening: Het Fort Hoofddijk is in 1877 – 1879 ten oosten van Utrecht gebouwd als onderdeel van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie.

facts.text: A thick earth cover shields the brick barracks from direct hits on all sides except the throat.
facts.sourceQuote: De kazerne is voorzien van een dikke aarddekking, zodat het metselwerk niet werd blootgesteld aan directe treffers. Alleen de keelzijde is onbedekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barracks is equipped with a thick earth cover, so that the masonry was not exposed to direct hits. Only the throat side is not covered.

facts.text: Nine distinct parts of the fort carry individual inscriptions in the national register of monuments.
facts.sourceQuote: Om precies te zijn, zijn er 9 onderdelen op het fort die een inschrijving in het rijksmonumentenregister hebben.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To be precise, there are 9 parts on the fort that have an inscription in the national register of monuments.

features.name: Miffy Museum
features.opening: Het nijntje museum (voorheen dick bruna huis) is een museum in het Museumkwartier van de Nederlandse stad Utrecht waar peuters en kleuters hun wereld kunnen…

facts.text: The venue opened on February 18, 2006 with the author present.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum werd op 18 februari 2006 als "dick bruna huis" geopend in aanwezigheid van de auteur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was opened on February 18, 2006 as the "Dick Bruna House" in the presence of the author.

facts.text: Over 1200 works by Dick Bruna are displayed here for visitors to admire.
facts.sourceQuote: Er waren meer dan 1200 werken van Dick Bruna te bewonderen, waaronder de nijntjeboeken en Bruna's eerste boekomslagen, affiches en zijn werk voor Amnesty International, het Rode Kruis en andere organisaties.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were more than 1200 works by Dick Bruna to admire, including the Peppa Pig books and Bruna's first book covers, posters and his work for Amnesty International, the Red Cross and other organizations.

features.name: Pniëlkerk
features.opening: De Pniëlkerk is een monumentaal kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Architects Piet Dingemans and Sjoerd Wouda designed this structure between 1954 and 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is gebouwd in 1954-1955 naar ontwerp van Piet Dingemans en Sjoerd Wouda.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1954-1955 according to the design of Piet Dingemans and Sjoerd Wouda.

features.name: Doopsgezinde kerk
features.opening: De Doopsgezinde kerk "Vermaning" in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht is gelegen aan de Oudegracht.

facts.text: Haarlem architect Willem de Haan directed the thorough renovation that created the current building.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij kwam in 1773 tot stand door een grondige verbouwing van een middeleeuws grachtenpand onder leiding van de Haarlemse bouwmeester Willem de Haan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was established in 1773 by a thorough renovation of a medieval canal house under the direction of the Haarlem architect Willem de Haan.

facts.text: Remarkable yellow windows were installed in 1922 while the organ dates to an 1870 Bätz company build.
facts.sourceQuote: De merkwaardige gele vensters dateren uit 1922, het orgel van de firma Bätz met een kast in neo-rococostijl is in 1870 gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The remarkable yellow windows date from 1922, the organ of the Bätz company with a cabinet in neo-Rococo style was built in 1870.

features.name: University Library City Centre
features.opening: De Universiteitsbibliotheek Utrecht (UB Utrecht of UBU) is de bibliotheek voor de wetenschappelijke informatievoorziening van de Universiteit Utrecht.

facts.text: The collection grew by 2,000 volumes in 1599 thanks to a legacy from canon Hubert van Buchell.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een legaat van de gewezen kanunnik Hubert van Buchell kon de stadsbibliotheek in 1599 met circa 2.000 banden worden uitgebreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a legacy from the former canon Hubert van Buchell, the city library was able to be expanded with about 2,000 volumes in 1599.

facts.text: Architect Wiel Arets designed the new Science Park building where 4.2 million books moved in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 verhuisden in totaal 4,2 miljoen boeken naar een nieuw gebouw in Utrecht Science Park, dat door architect Wiel Arets was ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, a total of 4.2 million books were moved to a new building in Utrecht Science Park, designed by architect Wiel Arets.

facts.text: Special Collections house manuscripts, pre-1901 books, rare volumes, and historical maps.
facts.sourceQuote: Daaronder zijn ook de Bijzondere Collecties met handschriften, boeken van voor 1901, zeldzame of kostbare boeken en kaarten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These include the Special Collections with manuscripts, books from before 1901, rare or valuable books and maps.

features.name: Sint-Catharinakathedraal
features.opening: St. Catherine's Cathedral (Dutch: Sint-Catharinakathedraal), often referred to as Catharijnekerk (Dutch for 'Catherine's Church'), is a Catholic church…

facts.text: A tower modeled after Kampen's town hall was added in 1900.
facts.sourceQuote: A tower, based on the tower of the town hall of Kampen, was added in 1900.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A tower, based on the tower of the town hall of Kampen, was added in 1900.

facts.text: Relics of Saint Willibrord rest beneath the main altar.
facts.sourceQuote: Some of the relics of Saint Willibrord, patron saint of the Benelux countries, are kept in the reliquary under the main altar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some of the relics of Saint Willibrord, patron saint of the Benelux countries, are kept in the reliquary under the main altar.

features.name: Paleis Lofen
features.opening: Lofen was een palts van de Duitse keizers die rond 1020 in Utrecht aan de burcht Trecht is gebouwd.

facts.text: Tuff stone formed the walls while a central row of sandstone columns divided the interior.
facts.sourceQuote: Het paleis is gebouwd in tufsteen en was in het midden verdeeld door een rij van zandstenen zuilen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was built of tuff and was divided in the middle by a row of sandstone columns.

facts.text: A city fire in 1253 likely destroyed the palace along with the Romanesque Cathedral.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1253 werd Lofen waarschijnlijk verwoest door een stadsbrand, die ook de romaanse Domkerk verwoestte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1253 Lofen was probably destroyed by a city fire, which also destroyed the Romanesque Cathedral.

facts.text: A 1122 charter called it the imperial palace in Utrecht, commonly known as Lofen.
facts.sourceQuote: In een oorkonde uit 1122 staat over Lofen in het Latijn: palacio imperatoris in Traiecto, quod vulgo Lofen dicitur, in vertaling "het keizerlijk paleis te Utrecht, dat in de volkstaal Lofen heet".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In a charter from 1122, Lofen is mentioned in Latin as: palacio imperatoris in Traiecto, quod vulgo Lofen dicitur, translated as "the imperial palace in Utrecht, which is commonly called Lofen in the vernacular".

features.name: Johanneskerk
features.opening: De Johanneskerk, ook bekend als het Johannescentrum, is een protestants kerkgebouw in de wijk Overvecht (Moezeldreef 400) in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Windows were designed to stop reaching the ground, preventing outside distractions and dramatic lighting.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook mochten de ramen niet tot de grond reiken waardoor men door de buitenwereld kon worden afgeleid, maar de ramen mochten ook geen dramatische lichtval geven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The windows were also not allowed to reach the ground so that people could not be distracted by the outside world, but the windows were also not allowed to give dramatic light.

facts.text: Construction started in 1965, with the church officially opening its doors just one year later in 1966.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw ving aan in 1965 en in 1966 werd de kerk in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1965 and the church was inaugurated in 1966.

facts.text: The facade eagle relief was designed by actor Carol Linssen, the son of the church's architect.
facts.sourceQuote: Het reliëf op de gevel, een adelaar, is ontworpen door acteur Carol Linssen, zoon van de architect.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The relief on the facade, an eagle, was designed by actor Carol Linssen, son of the architect.

features.name: Abdij van St. Paulus
features.opening: St. Paul's Abbey was a monastery in Utrecht in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, the abbey church was consecrated on 26 June 1050.
facts.sourceQuote: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, the abbey church was consecrated on 26 June 1050.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, the abbey church was consecrated on 26 June 1050.

facts.text: Constructed from tuff stone, the Romanesque building featured twin towers at its west end.
facts.sourceQuote: Paul's Abbey church was a Romanesque building with a conventional three-part nave (incorporating a side aisle on each side of the main nave). It was constructed from tuff stone and featured twin towers at its west end.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Paul's Abbey church was a Romanesque building with a conventional three-part nave (incorporating a side aisle on each side of the main nave). It was constructed from tuff stone and featured twin towers at its west end.

facts.text: Most of the nave was demolished in 1707, followed by the choir in 1804.
facts.sourceQuote: Most of the nave of the church was demolished in 1707, and the choir met the same fate in 1804.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Most of the nave of the church was demolished in 1707, and the choir met the same fate in 1804.

facts.text: Today only a transept wall survives, integrated into the row of houses lining Hofpoort Street.
facts.sourceQuote: Today all that survives of the church is a section of transept wall, integrated into the row of substantial houses that now lines the Hofpoort Street.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today all that survives of the church is a section of transept wall, integrated into the row of substantial houses that now lines the Hofpoort Street.

features.name: Pauluskerk
features.opening: De Willem de Zwijgerkerk of Sint-Pauluskerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk aan het Willem de Zwijgerplantsoen in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Declining attendance led to the church closing in 1991 before a Catholic parish took it over two years later.
facts.sourceQuote: Wegens teruglopend kerkbezoek werd de kerk in 1991 buiten dienst genomen. In 1993 werd de kerk overgedragen aan de katholieke Sint-Paulusparochie, die in datzelfde jaar haar oude Pauluskerk aan de Linnaeuslaan verliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to declining church attendance, the church was taken out of service in 1991. In 1993, the church was transferred to the Catholic St. Paul's parish, which in the same year left its old Pauluskerk on Linnaeuslaan.

facts.text: A roof fin sits atop the structure, adding a distinct vertical element.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het dak staat een dakruiter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a roof fin on the roof.

features.name: Ridderhofstad Den Engh
features.opening: Den Engh is een voormalig kasteel en ridderhofstad bij Vleuten, gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht.

facts.text: The castle was demolished in 1898 and its stones were sold off.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1898 werd het kasteel gesloopt en werden de stenen verkocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1898 the castle was demolished and the stones were sold.

features.name: Utrechtsch Studenten Corps
features.opening: Het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps, kortweg U.S.C., de oudste studentenvereniging van Utrecht, werd nooit opgericht maar ontstond gaandeweg.

facts.text: Although often dated to 1816, that year actually marks the founding of a different society called Placet Hic Requiescere Musis.
facts.sourceQuote: Vaak wordt als oprichtingsjaar 1816 aangehouden, maar dat is in feite slechts het oprichtingsjaar van de sociëteit Placet Hic Requiescere Musis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Often 1816 is considered the founding year, but that is in fact only the founding year of the society Placet Hic Requiescere Musis.

features.name: Fort bij Rijnauwen
features.opening: Fort bij Rijnauwen is een Nederlands fort bij de buurtschap Rhijnauwen in de gemeente Bunnik.

facts.text: Construction costs reached 766,242 guilders plus 142,338 for land expropriation.
facts.sourceQuote: De uitvoeringskosten bedroegen 766.242 gulden en daarbij kwam nog eens 142.338 gulden voor de onteigening van de grond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The execution costs amounted to 766,242 guilders and an additional 142,338 guilders for the expropriation of the land.

facts.text: The rear neckfront spans 420 meters and features an inward-curving corner.
facts.sourceQuote: Het keelfront, of de achterzijde van het fort, is 420 meter lang met een inspringende hoek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The neckfront, or the rear of the fort, is 420 meters long with an inward-curving corner.

features.name: Utrecht Archives Expo
features.opening: The Utrecht Archives (Dutch: Het Utrechts Archief (HUA)) is a records department in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: The archive moved from a city gate used for gunpowder storage to the Lichtenberg house in 1546.
facts.sourceQuote: Due to the fact that this gate was also used as a place to store gunpowder, the city archive had to be moved to another location. From 1546 it was placed in a house called ‘Lichtenberg’ located at the ‘Stadhuisbrug’.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the fact that this gate was also used as a place to store gunpowder, the city archive had to be moved to another location. From 1546 it was placed in a house called ‘Lichtenberg’ located at the ‘Stadhuisbrug’.

facts.text: The Dutch Railways keep their official records here.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides, the national centre for ecclesiastical records is located in the Utrecht Archives together with the records of the Dutch Railways.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides, the national centre for ecclesiastical records is located in the Utrecht Archives together with the records of the Dutch Railways.

features.name: Triumfatorkerk
features.opening: De Triumfatorkerk is een monumentaal kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: The Seventh-day Adventist Church bought the church in 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017 is de Triumfatorkerk aangekocht door het Kerkgenootschap der Zevende-dags Adventisten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, the Triumfatorkerk was purchased by the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

facts.text: A new organ by Van Vulpen with hand-carved details entered use in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 8 maart 1974 werd een nieuw orgel van Van Vulpen in gebruik genomen waarvan het snijwerk van de hand is van Jeannot Bürgi.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 8, 1974, a new organ by Van Vulpen was put into use, whose carving is by hand of Jeannot Bürgi.

features.name: De Inktpot
features.opening: De Inktpot is het grootste bakstenen gebouw in Nederland, ontworpen door George van Heukelom in opdracht van de belangenmaatschap Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS).

facts.text: A common misconception claims the German SS used it as headquarters during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat de Duitse SS De Inktpot als hoofdkantoor zou hebben gebruikt, is een veelgehoord misverstand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That the German SS De Inktpot would have used as its headquarters is a common misconception.

facts.text: George van Heukelom designed this structure for the public interest company Dutch Railways.
facts.sourceQuote: De Inktpot is het grootste bakstenen gebouw in Nederland, ontworpen door George van Heukelom in opdracht van de belangenmaatschap Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Inktpot is the largest brick building in the Netherlands, designed by George van Heukelom on behalf of the public interest company Dutch Railways (NS).

facts.text: ProRail has used the site as its headquarters since 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: Het rijksmonument staat aan het Moreelsepark in Utrecht bij Station Utrecht Centraal en het wordt sinds 1995 gebruikt als hoofdkantoor van ProRail.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The national monument is located in Moreelsepark in Utrecht near Utrecht Central Station and has been used as the headquarters of ProRail since 1995.

features.name: Holy Trinity Church
features.opening: De Holy Trinity Church is een anglicaanse parochiekerk in de Utrechtse wijk Oudwijk aan het Van Limburg Stirumplein bij de Van Limburg Stirumstraat, gewijd aan…

facts.text: Anglican bishop Herbert Bury laid the first stone on November 9, 1911.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen werd gelegd op 9 november 1911 door de anglicaanse bisschop voor Noord-Europa Herbert Bury.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone was laid on November 9, 1911 by the Anglican bishop for Northern Europe Herbert Bury.

facts.text: Stained glass windows by Henry Bosdet were installed between 1913 and 1925.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, de glas-in-loodramen zijn van de hand van Henry Bosdet en zijn geplaatst in de periode tussen 1913 en 1925.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, the stained glass windows were made by Henry Bosdet and were installed between 1913 and 1925.

features.name: Dom tower
features.opening: The Dom Tower (Dutch: Domtoren 'Cathedral Tower') of Utrecht is the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, at 112.32 metres (368.5 feet) in height.

facts.text: Preacher Geert Groote protested the tower's construction as an act of vanity.
facts.sourceQuote: Its construction led preacher Geert Groote to protest against the vanity of such an immense project, suggesting it was too tall, too expensive and all but aesthetic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its construction led preacher Geert Groote to protest against the vanity of such an immense project, suggesting it was too tall, too expensive and all but aesthetic.

facts.text: Restorations in 1910 raised the height from 109 to 112.5 metres.
facts.sourceQuote: Upon completion in 1382 the tower stood 109 metres tall. However the height was increased during the restorations in 1910, to its present height of 112.5 metres.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Upon completion in 1382 the tower stood 109 metres tall. However the height was increased during the restorations in 1910, to its present height of 112.5 metres.

facts.text: A private chapel for the Bishop occupied the first floor alongside the belfry.
facts.sourceQuote: In addition to being a belfry, it contained a private chapel of the Bishop of Utrecht on the first floor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to being a belfry, it contained a private chapel of the Bishop of Utrecht on the first floor.

facts.text: Since the nave collapsed in 1674, the tower has stood alone as a freestanding structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Since the unfinished nave collapsed in 1674, the Dom tower has been a freestanding tower.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the unfinished nave collapsed in 1674, the Dom tower has been a freestanding tower.

facts.text: Standing at 112.32 metres, it remains the tallest church tower in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dom Tower (Dutch: Domtoren 'Cathedral Tower') of Utrecht is the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, at 112.32 metres (368.5 feet) in height.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dom Tower (Dutch: Domtoren 'Cathedral Tower') of Utrecht is the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, at 112.32 metres (368.5 feet) in height.

features.name: Houtzaagmolen De Ster
features.opening: Houtzaagmolen de Ster is het middelpunt van het Molenerf de Ster, een van de weinige vrijwel compleet bewaard gebleven houtzaagmolenerven van Nederland.

facts.text: Houtzaagmolen De Ster takes its name from its first owner, Arien van der Starren.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de molen De Ster is afgeleid van de naam van de eerste eigenaar Arien van der Starren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the mill De Ster is derived from the name of the first owner Arien van der Starren.

facts.text: Mill builder Poland assembled the structure piece by piece in a shed in Broek op Langedijk with four men.
facts.sourceQuote: Begin 1998 startten de aannemer Jurriëns en molenbouwer Poland met hun werkzaamheden. In zijn loods in Broek op Langedijk in Noord-Holland bouwde molenbouwer Poland met vier man de molen stukje voor stukje op.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of 1998, the contractor Jurriëns and mill builder Poland started their work. In his shed in Broek op Langedijk in North Holland, mill builder Poland built the mill piece by piece with four men.

facts.text: The massive upper shaft weighs 3500 kilograms and measures 6.01 meters in length.
facts.sourceQuote: Half februari 1998 is door de ijzergieterij Gieterij Hardinxveld te Hardinxveld-Giesendam de reusachtige bovenas van De Ster gegoten. Deze kolos van 6,01 meter lang heeft een doorsnede van 50 centimeter, weegt 3500 kilo en heeft nummer 79.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In mid-February 1998, the gigantic upper shaft of De Ster was cast by the iron foundry Gieterij Hardinxveld in Hardinxveld-Giesendam. This colossus 6.01 meters long has a cross-section of 50 centimeters, weighs 3500 kilograms and has number 79.

facts.text: To catch wind, the municipality knotted poplar trees at a height of about 4.5 meters in March 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Om de molen voldoende wind te doen vangen, heeft de gemeente begin maart 1999 de populierenlaan in het Molenpark grondig aangepakt. De populieren zijn geknot op een hoogte van zo'n 4,5 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to catch enough wind for the mill, the municipality thoroughly renovated the poplar lane in the Molenpark at the beginning of March 1999. The poplars are knotted at a height of about 4.5 meters.

features.name: Esperantomonument
features.opening: Esperantomonumenten in Nederland zijn opgericht ter ere van de taal Esperanto en/of de schepper van die taal, Lejzer Zamenhof.

facts.text: Artist Tjeerd Visser crafted a three-meter brass statue with a thick base and pointed tip.
facts.sourceQuote: Kunstenaar Tjeerd Visser ontwierp een drie meter hoog messing beeld dat de strijd weerspiegelt om het Esperanto-ideaal te verwezenlijken; de forse onderkant van het beeld is de grote moeite die gedaan is, en de spits toelopende punt verwijst naar het doel: "van chaos naar gerichtheid en eenheid".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Artist Tjeerd Visser designed a three-meter-high brass statue that reflects the struggle to realize the Esperanto ideal; the thick bottom of the statue is the great effort made, and the pointed tip refers to the goal: "from chaos to direction and unity".

facts.text: The sculptures feature five-pointed stars and globes to symbolize the five continents.
facts.sourceQuote: Toegepaste symboliek in de monumenten zijn onder andere de vijfpuntige ster en de wereldbol, verwijzend naar de vijf werelddelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Applied symbolism in the monuments includes the five-pointed star and the globe, referring to the five continents.

features.name: Verzetsmonument
features.opening: Het verzetsmonument op het Domplein in Utrecht is een oorlogsmonument ter ere van het Nederlands verzet in de Tweede Wereldoorlog.

facts.text: The statue's model was Johanna Antoinette de Boer, whose parents were friends with the sculptor.
facts.sourceQuote: Johanna Antoinette de Boer, gehuwd Blakenburg, (geboren 02-01-1929 overleden 01-10-2025) stond model voor dit kunstwerk. Haar ouders waren bevriend met de kunstenares.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Johanna Antoinette de Boer, married Blakenburg, (born 02-01-1929 died 01-10-2025) was the model for this work of art. Her parents were friends with the artist.

facts.text: The artist carved the figure from a boiler house originally built for The Hague gas factory.
facts.sourceQuote: Franzén-Heslenfeld hakte het beeld in een ketelhuis van de Haagse gasfabriek, ze werd bij de uitvoering geassisteerd door Giuseppe Roverso en Wladimir de Vries.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Franzén-Heslenfeld carved the image into a boiler house from the Hague gas factory, she was assisted by Giuseppe Roverso and Wladimir de Vries during the execution.

facts.text: Prince Bernhard unveiled the completed monument on May 4, 1949.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op 4 mei 1949 onthuld door prins Bernhard.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was unveiled on May 4, 1949 by Prince Bernhard.

facts.text: A lottery raising 8000 guilders helped finance the construction of this memorial.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd deels gefinancierd met een opbrengst van 8000 gulden uit een loterij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was partly financed with a revenue of 8000 guilders from a lottery.

facts.text: A female figure was chosen specifically because of the high proportion of Utrecht women in the resistance.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is bewust gekozen voor een vrouwenfiguur, vanwege het aandeel van de Utrechtse vrouwen in het verzet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A female figure was deliberately chosen, due to the proportion of Utrecht women in the resistance.

facts.text: The base features a poem by Jan Engelman urging people to carry on the flame of those who fought.
facts.sourceQuote: In de sokkel is een gedicht aangebracht van Jan Engelman: Gedenk uw dooden die den goeden strijd gestreden hebben in gerechtigheid. Draagt voort hun vlam, zij zijn gebleven, maar in dien gloed wordt ons nieuw leven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the base is a poem by Jan Engelman: Remember your dead who fought the good fight in justice. Carry on their flame, they have remained, but in that glow is our new life.

features.name: Rietveld-Schröderhuis
features.opening: The Rietveld Schröder House (Dutch: Rietveld Schröderhuis; also known as the Schröder House) in Utrecht (Prins Hendriklaan 50) was built in 1924 by Dutch…

facts.text: The house included a garage even though its owner, Truus Schröder, never owned a car.
facts.sourceQuote: Additionally, the house included a garage, which was very strange because Truus did not own a car.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Additionally, the house included a garage, which was very strange because Truus did not own a car.

facts.text: Concrete was initially planned but deemed too costly for the small structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Initially, Rietveld wanted to construct the house out of concrete. It turned out that it would be too expensive to do that on such a small building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, Rietveld wanted to construct the house out of concrete. It turned out that it would be too expensive to do that on such a small building.

facts.text: Only the foundations and balconies were built from concrete while walls used brick.
facts.sourceQuote: The foundations and the balconies were the only parts of the building that were made out of concrete. The walls were made of brick and plaster.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The foundations and the balconies were the only parts of the building that were made out of concrete. The walls were made of brick and plaster.

features.name: Nederlands Volksbuurt Museum
features.opening: Het Volksbuurtmuseum is een museum gelegen in Utrecht aan de Waterstraat 27.

facts.text: Residents voluntarily donated personal belongings and shared stories to build the museum's collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Buurtbewoners leverden op verzoek persoonlijke bezittingen aan en lieten zich interviewen om de identiteit van de wijk in leven te houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Neighbors voluntarily handed over personal belongings upon request and were interviewed to keep the identity of the neighborhood alive.

facts.text: One hundred years ago, this area housed the city's most densely populated district with large families in small shanties.
facts.sourceQuote: Wijk C was 100 jaar geleden de dichtstbevolkte wijk van Utrecht. In de wijk woonden grote gezinnen in kleine krotwoningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: District C was the most densely populated district of Utrecht 100 years ago. Large families lived in small shanty houses in the neighborhood.

features.name: Jacob de Vries
features.opening: De lijst van Stolpersteine in Utrecht (gemeente) geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in de gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht zijn…

facts.text: The first Stolperstein in Utrecht honored Josephina Joosten-Groen, not Jacob de Vries.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Stolperstein die in de stad Utrecht geplaatst is, was voor Josephina Joosten-Groen, die vrijwillig met haar man meeging naar Westerbork.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Stolperstein placed in the city of Utrecht was for Josephina Joosten-Groen, who voluntarily went with her husband to Westerbork.

features.name: Wilhelminakerk
features.opening: De Wilhelminakerk is een kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Construction of the church was completed around the year 1931.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw is omstreeks 1931 gebouwd in de Schildersbuurt op de hoek van de Hobbemastraat met de Paulus Potterstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was built around 1931 in the Schildersbuurt on the corner of Hobbemastraat and Paulus Potterstraat.

features.name: Museum Catharijneconvent
features.opening: The Museum Catharijneconvent (St. Catherine's Convent Museum) is a museum of religious art in Utrecht, Netherlands.

facts.text: The convent closed in 2006 for a major restoration project.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2006 the convent closed for restoration.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2006 the convent closed for restoration.

facts.text: Museum Catharijneconvent (St. Catherine's Convent Museum) occupies the former St. Catharine convent.
facts.sourceQuote: It is located in the former St. Catharine convent, having been sited there since 1979.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is located in the former St. Catharine convent, having been sited there since 1979.

facts.text: A 9th-century chalice of Saint Lebuinus is a standout treasure in the museum's collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the highlights in the collection are the 9th-century chalice of Saint Lebuinus and carved ivories from the Lebuïnuskerk in Deventer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the highlights in the collection are the 9th-century chalice of Saint Lebuinus and carved ivories from the Lebuïnuskerk in Deventer.

facts.text: Works by Dutch painters Jan van Scorel and Pieter Saenredam represent the 16th and 17th centuries here.
facts.sourceQuote: Dutch painting of the 16th and 17th centuries is represented by a selection of works by Jan van Scorel and Pieter Saenredam, and more recent Dutch artworks by Jan Toorop, Shinkichi Tajiri, Frans Franciscus, Guido van der Werve and Marc Mulders.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dutch painting of the 16th and 17th centuries is represented by a selection of works by Jan van Scorel and Pieter Saenredam, and more recent Dutch artworks by Jan Toorop, Shinkichi Tajiri, Frans Franciscus, Guido van der Werve and Marc Mulders.

features.name: Museum Speelklok
features.opening: Museum Speelklok (previously known as Museum van Speelklok tot Pierement) is a museum in Utrecht, Netherlands, specializing in self-playing musical instruments.

facts.text: Since 1984, the collection has been displayed inside the medieval Buurkerk church.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1984 the museum has been housed in the central medieval Buurkerk (citizens' church) and was officially opened by Queen Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1984 the museum has been housed in the central medieval Buurkerk (citizens' church) and was officially opened by Queen Beatrix.

facts.text: The name 'Speelklok' literally translates to musical clock.
facts.sourceQuote: The word speelklok means musical clock.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The word speelklok means musical clock.

features.name: Kathedrale Kerk van Sint-Gertrudis
features.opening: St. Gertrude's Cathedral (Dutch: Sint-Gertrudiskathedraal) in Utrecht, the Netherlands, is the seat of the Archbishop of Utrecht and the mother church of the…

facts.text: Architect E.G. Wentinck designed the building in a style echoing St. Mary's Church.
facts.sourceQuote: The current church building was constructed between 1912 and 1914, and was designed by E.G. Wentinck (nl) in Neo-Romanesque style, echoing St. Mary's Church, which formerly stood on the Mariaplaats, very close by.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current church building was constructed between 1912 and 1914, and was designed by E.G. Wentinck (nl) in Neo-Romanesque style, echoing St. Mary's Church, which formerly stood on the Mariaplaats, very close by.

facts.text: Over 1700 relics sit in hundreds of containers above a supposed rib of St. Willibrord.
facts.sourceQuote: In the altar there are more than 1700 relics in hundreds of containers. Underneath these relics there is supposed to be a piece of a rib of St. Willibrord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the altar there are more than 1700 relics in hundreds of containers. Underneath these relics there is supposed to be a piece of a rib of St. Willibrord.

facts.text: The original chapel was constructed in 1634 inside a medieval house.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built in 1634 within a mediaeval house as a clandestine church for the members of the Roman Catholic parish of the Geertekerk (nl) (the original St.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1634 within a mediaeval house as a clandestine church for the members of the Roman Catholic parish of the Geertekerk (nl) (the original St.

features.name: Hogeschool Utrecht
features.opening: The University of Applied Sciences Utrecht (HU) is a higher vocational university in Utrecht, Netherlands.

facts.text: In 1988, the institution formed by merging several polytechnics became known as Hogeschool van Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuote: The Hogeschool van Utrecht (HvU) was created in 1988 through a merger of several polytechnics schools in the city and province of Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hogeschool van Utrecht (HvU) was created in 1988 through a merger of several polytechnics schools in the city and province of Utrecht.

facts.text: In April 2021, its Celsius student team won three awards in a US Department of Energy Solar Decathlon.
facts.sourceQuote: On April 19, 2021, it was announced that the Celsius student team won three awards in the Solar Decathlon Build Challenge held by United States Department of Energy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 19, 2021, it was announced that the Celsius student team won three awards in the Solar Decathlon Build Challenge held by United States Department of Energy.

features.name: Louis Hartog Frijda

facts.text: Stolpersteine honor victims like him who were persecuted, deported, or murdered by the Nazi regime.
facts.sourceQuote: Stolpersteine zijn opgedragen aan slachtoffers van het nationaalsocialisme, al diegenen die zijn vervolgd, gedeporteerd, vermoord, gedwongen te emigreren of tot zelfmoord gedreven door het nazi-regime.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were persecuted, deported, murdered, forced to emigrate or driven to suicide by the Nazi regime.

features.name: Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen
features.opening: Het Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen in Utrecht staat in Park Nieuweroord, vlak bij de NS-hoofdgebouwen, De Inktpot en het Centraal Station Utrecht.

facts.text: The idea emerged in 2001 after a victim's relative requested a memorial for the Harmelen disaster.
facts.sourceQuote: Begin 2001 verzocht een nabestaande van een slachtoffer van de treinramp bij Harmelen (1962) de NS om een monument voor dit ongeval.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of 2001, a relative of a victim of the train disaster in Harmelen (1962) asked the NS to erect a monument for this accident.

features.name: PVCV
features.opening: PVCV (Patronaats Voetbalclub Vleuten) is een amateurvoetbalvereniging uit Vleuten in de Nederlandse gemeente Utrecht in de gelijknamige provincie.

facts.text: PVCV traditionally competed in the Sunday league before switching to Saturday play in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: Van oudsher speelde het eerste elftal van PVCV in de zondagcompetitie. In het seizoen 2022/23 werd overgestapt naar de zaterdagcompetitie, middels een 'horizontale' overstapregeling van de KNVB kon de club op zaterdag in dezelfde klasse verder. = Dit seizoen werd stopgezet vanwege de uitbraak van het coronavirus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Traditionally, PVCV's first team played in the Sunday competition. In the 2022/23 season, the club switched to the Saturday competition, thanks to a 'horizontal' transfer scheme of the KNVB, the club could continue in the same class on Saturday. = This season was suspended due to the outbreak of the coronavirus.

features.name: Hercules
features.opening: Utrechtse Sportvereniging Hercules (Utrecht Sports Association Hercules), also known as USV Hercules, Hercules Utrecht or simply Hercules, is an amateur…

facts.text: During the 2017 KNVB Cup, Hercules led FC Groningen 1–0 before ultimately losing 2–1.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017, USV Hercules led 1–0 against FC Groningen in the national KNVB Cup but went on to lose the game 2–1.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, USV Hercules led 1–0 against FC Groningen in the national KNVB Cup but went on to lose the game 2–1.

facts.text: The club reached the Derde Divisie in 2014 after just one season in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2014 it joined the Derde Divisie (then still known as Topklasse) after playing just one year in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2014 it joined the Derde Divisie (then still known as Topklasse) after playing just one year in the Hoofdklasse.

features.name: TivoliVredenburg
features.opening: The TivoliVredenburg is a contemporary music complex located in Utrecht, Netherlands.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander officially inaugurated the venue on July 3, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Official opening ceremonies began on 27 June 2014, with the venue being inaugurated by King Willem-Alexander on 3 July 2014.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Official opening ceremonies began on 27 June 2014, with the venue being inaugurated by King Willem-Alexander on 3 July 2014.

facts.text: Rubber suspension was installed in support pillars to stop sound bleeding between halls.
facts.sourceQuote: In June 2015, the venue fixed complaints of sound bleed between the Ronda and Hertz halls with the placement of rubber suspension in the building's support pillars and sound-insulating plates in the Ronda's roof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 2015, the venue fixed complaints of sound bleed between the Ronda and Hertz halls with the placement of rubber suspension in the building's support pillars and sound-insulating plates in the Ronda's roof.

facts.text: A cleaner fatally stabbed a coworker during a fight inside the venue in November 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: In November 2023, a fatal stabbing took place in TivoliVredenburg. The suspect was a cleaner who killed his coworker after a fight.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2023, a fatal stabbing took place in TivoliVredenburg. The suspect was a cleaner who killed his coworker after a fight.

facts.text: The old Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to clear space for the new site.
facts.sourceQuote: All plans were approved by the city in 2010 and the Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to make way for the new music venue, which was originally given the name Muziekpaleis Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All plans were approved by the city in 2010 and the Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to make way for the new music venue, which was originally given the name Muziekpaleis Utrecht.

features.name: Sint-Aloysiuskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Aloysiuskerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht, in de subwijk/buurt Abstede in de wijk Oost.

facts.text: The organ dates from 1810 and was moved here after its original church was demolished.
facts.sourceQuote: Het uit 1810 daterende tweeklaviers orgel is afkomstig uit de gesloopte Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-ten-Hemelopnemingkerk (Biltstraatkerk).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The two-manual organ dating from 1810 comes from the demolished Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-ten-Hemelopnemingkerk (Biltstraatkerk).

facts.text: Bishop Gerard de Korte was ordained a priest within these walls.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bossche bisschop Gerard de Korte werd in deze kerk tot priester gewijd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bishop of Bossum, Gerard de Korte, was ordained a priest in this church.

facts.text: A secret church stood on this site from 1600 to 1715 before moving away.
facts.sourceQuote: 1600 tot 1715 was in een schuur aan de Abstederdijk een schuilkerk gevestigd onder de naam "Statie onder het Kruis" (nu de boerderij op nummer 188).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1600 to 1715, a secret church was located in a barn on the Abstederdijk under the name "Statie onder het Kruis" (now the farm at number 188).

features.name: Hugo Wstinc
features.opening: Hugo Wstinc (?

facts.text: A bronze statue of him writing was created by Jan Hendrik Brom.
facts.sourceQuote: Begin 20e eeuw werd in de pandhof van de Dom een door Edelsmidse Brom gemaakte fontein geplaatst, met daarop een bronzen beeldje van een schrijvende Wstinc. Het werd ontworpen door Jan Hendrik Brom en uitgevoerd door zijn zoons Jan Eloy en Leo Brom.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of the 20th century, a fountain made by Edelsmidse Brom was placed in the courtyard of the Cathedral, with a bronze statue of a writing Wstinc on it. It was designed by Jan Hendrik Brom and executed by his sons Jan Eloy and Leo Brom.

features.name: Buurkerk
features.opening: The Buurkerk is a former church building in Utrecht (city), Netherlands on the Buurkerkhof.

facts.text: The name Buurkerk combines buur (neighbour) and kerk (church).
facts.sourceQuote: The name Buurkerk is made up of the words buur (neighbour) and kerk (church).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Buurkerk is made up of the words buur (neighbour) and kerk (church).

facts.text: A council chapel was later added to the structure for formal meetings.
facts.sourceQuote: Eventually a small raadskapel (council chapel) was built as part of the church's structure for more formal meetings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eventually a small raadskapel (council chapel) was built as part of the church's structure for more formal meetings.

facts.text: Prominent citizens gathered on the square west of the church for governance.
facts.sourceQuote: Prominent citizens, politicians, and guild members would gather on the square to the west of the church for general business and matters of governance.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prominent citizens, politicians, and guild members would gather on the square to the west of the church for general business and matters of governance.

facts.text: The tower was started in 1370 but was never finished.
facts.sourceQuote: The tower dates from 1370, but was never finished.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower dates from 1370, but was never finished.

facts.text: A cannon aimed at Vredenburg castle was installed in the tower in 1577.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at the Vredenburg castle where the Charles V's Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at the Vredenburg castle where the Charles V's Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.

facts.text: The old choir was removed to make room for a street now called Choorstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: Around 1580 the church endured the protestant reformation and in 1586 it was formally handed over to the protestants, who whitewashed the wall decorations and removed the choir to make room for a street. The Choorstraat, which is named after the deconstructed choir, still has the outlines of the old choir in the pavement.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1580 the church endured the protestant reformation and in 1586 it was formally handed over to the protestants, who whitewashed the wall decorations and removed the choir to make room for a street. The Choorstraat, which is named after the deconstructed choir, still has the outlines of the old choir in the pavement.

features.name: Motion Church
features.opening: De Marcuskerk is een monumentaal kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: The Dutch Reformed Church held its final service at the site in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2018 hadden de Nederlands-hervormden er hun laatste dienst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2018, the Dutch Reformed Church held its last service there.

features.name: Ulu Moskee
features.opening: The Ulu Mosque in Utrecht is located at the Mosque square; the first square or street in the Netherlands named after an Islamic religious building.

facts.text: A unique contemplation room for all denominations was created due to the local Christian and Jewish populations.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides the Islamic prayer hall, the building also host a room for contemplation for people from any other denomination. The board of the mosque decided to create such a room, unique in the world, since the neighborhood surrounding the mosque has also a substantial Christian and Jewish population.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides the Islamic prayer hall, the building also host a room for contemplation for people from any other denomination. The board of the mosque decided to create such a room, unique in the world, since the neighborhood surrounding the mosque has also a substantial Christian and Jewish population.

facts.text: The mosque was formally opened in October 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: The mosque was formally opened in October 2015.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosque was formally opened in October 2015.

features.name: Mattheuskerk
features.opening: De Mattheüskerk is een protestants kerkgebouw aan de Hendrika van Tussenbroeklaan in de wijk Oog in Al in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Architect Gijs van Hoogevest designed the church while also restoring five medieval Utrecht churches.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor het ontwerp werd Gijs van Hoogevest aangetrokken. Hij en zijn zoon Teus waren in die tijd ook betrokken bij de restauratie van vijf middeleeuwse kerken in de Utrechtse binnenstad, waaronder de Domkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Gijs van Hoogevest was recruited for the design. He and his son Teus were also involved at that time in the restoration of five medieval churches in the Utrecht city center, including the Dom Church.

facts.text: Father and son Gijs and Teus van Hoogevest designed the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw werd in 1952 gebouwd naar een ontwerp van vader en zoon Gijs en Teus van Hoogevest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was built in 1952 according to a design by father and son Gijs and Teus van Hoogevest.

facts.text: Originally Dutch Reformed, it became Christian Reformed in 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk was oorspronkelijk Nederlands Hervormd, maar is sinds 1996 Christelijk Gereformeerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was originally Dutch Reformed, but has been Christian Reformed since 1996.

features.name: Protestantse Theologische Universiteit
features.opening: Protestant Theological University (abbreviated as PThU; Dutch: Protestantse Theologische Universiteit) is a theological university with locations in the Dutch…

facts.text: The institution was originally named Theologische School before becoming a college in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: The university was founded in 1854 as the Theological School ("Theologische School") by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834, to provide for theological education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939 and finally to Theological University in 1986, after a reform in the Dutch university/polytechnic system.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university was founded in 1854 as the Theological School ("Theologische School") by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834, to provide for theological education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939 and finally to Theological University in 1986, after a reform in the Dutch university/polytechnic system.

facts.text: A 1944 schism led to the founding of Kampen Theological University from parts of this school.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Church in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation ("Vrijmaking"), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new university was founded from parts of the Theological University: Kampen Theological University of the Reformed Church (Liberated).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Church in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation ("Vrijmaking"), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new university was founded from parts of the Theological University: Kampen Theological University of the Reformed Church (Liberated).

facts.text: After merging into the Protestant Church in 2004, it became part of the PKN.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Reformed Church in the Netherlands merged with the Dutch Reformed Church and the Evangelical Lutheran Church in 2004 to form the Protestant Church in the Netherlands (PKN), the Protestant Theological University became part of the PKN.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Reformed Church in the Netherlands merged with the Dutch Reformed Church and the Evangelical Lutheran Church in 2004 to form the Protestant Church in the Netherlands (PKN), the Protestant Theological University became part of the PKN.

facts.text: The institution is one of three institutes officially recognised by the PKN for ministerial education.
facts.sourceQuote: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.

facts.text: Students can study general Calvinist theology here without intending to become ministers.
facts.sourceQuote: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.

features.name: St. Dominicuskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Dominicuskerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht, gelegen in de wijk Oog in Al.

facts.text: Herman van Putten designed the church in the distinctive Bossche School style.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is gebouwd in 1951 en ontworpen door Herman van Putten in de stijl van de Bossche School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1951 and designed by Herman van Putten in the style of the Bossche School.

facts.text: Bishop Alfrink consecrated the building on November 22, 1951.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 22 november 1951 werd de kerk ingewijd door mgr. Alfrink.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On November 22, 1951, the church was consecrated by Bishop. Alfrink.

facts.text: Dominican fathers maintained a small community here until it dissolved in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de oprichting hebben de paters dominicanen er een kleine communiteit gehad. In 1992 werd de communiteit opgeheven, maar de dominicaanse spiritualiteit wordt nog steeds doorgegeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since its founding, the Dominican fathers have had a small community there. The community was dissolved in 1992, but Dominican spirituality is still being passed down.

facts.text: In 2010, this church merged with five others to form the Ludgerus Parish.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 fuseerde de Dominicuskerk met vijf andere kerken in Utrecht tot de Ludgerusparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, Dominicuskerk merged with five other churches in Utrecht to form the Ludgerus Parish.

features.name: Janskerk
features.opening: De Janskerk staat op het Janskerkhof in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: A 1674 storm collapsed the ship, leading to the westwork's final demolition in 1681.
facts.sourceQuote: Het romaanse westwerk is in stappen verdwenen: in de 14e eeuw is de noordelijke toren waarschijnlijk al ingestort; de zomerstorm van 1674, die met een tornado onder meer het schip van de Dom omverblies, bracht verdere schade aan, en de laatste resten van het westwerk, inclusief de zuidelijke toren, werden in 1681 gesloopt en vervangen door een eenvoudige nieuwe gevel naar ontwerp van Ghijsbert Theunisz. van Vianen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Romanesque westwork gradually disappeared: in the 14th century the northern tower was probably already collapsed; the summer storm of 1674, which with a tornado blew over the ship of the Dom among other things, caused further damage, and the last remains of the westwork, including the southern tower, were demolished in 1681 and replaced by a simple new facade designed by Ghijsbert Theunisz. van Vianen.

facts.text: Original round red sandstone columns were rebuilt as square pillars in the thirteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: De ronde zuilen uit rode zandsteen werden echter in de dertiende eeuw ommetseld tot vierkante pijlers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the round columns of red sandstone were rebuilt in the thirteenth century into square pillars.

facts.text: Bishop Bernold founded this church as part of an alleged church cross layout.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze drie kerken werden door bisschop Bernold gesticht als onderdeel van een vermeend kerkenkruis, waarvan de Janskerk de noordelijke punt vormde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These three churches were founded by Bishop Bernold as part of an alleged church cross, of which the Janskerk formed the northern point.

facts.text: Bishop Bernold founded the church shortly after 1040.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze werd kort na 1040 gesticht door bisschop Bernold en gewijd aan Johannes de Doper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist.

facts.text: The Janskerk is dedicated to John the Baptist.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze werd kort na 1040 gesticht door bisschop Bernold en gewijd aan Johannes de Doper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist.

facts.text: Twenty canons were attached to the chapter of St. John.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het kapittel van Sint-Jan waren twintig kanunniken verbonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Twenty canons were attached to the chapter of St. John.

features.name: KidZcity
features.opening: KidZcity is een overdekt pretpark in Utrecht, ook wel een indoor attractiepark genoemd.

facts.text: A large fire broke out on April 18, 2008, though no visitors were injured.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 18 april 2008 woedde er een grote brand in KidZcity. Hoewel er publiek aanwezig was op het moment dat de brand uitbrak zijn er geen bezoekers gewond geraakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 18, 2008, a large fire broke out in KidZcity. Although there was a public presence at the time the fire broke out, no visitors were injured.

facts.text: The venue was renovated and reopened during the autumn holidays of 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: KidZcity werd gerenoveerd en sinds de herfstvakantie van 2008 is het weer geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: KidZcity was renovated and has been open again since the autumn holidays of 2008.

facts.text: Children up to age 12 can climb, slide, run, and jump inside the park.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier kunnen kinderen tot 12 jaar klimmen, glijden, rennen en springen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here children up to 12 years old can climb, slide, run and jump.

facts.text: The venue features attractions like Ferris wheels, laser games, and bumper cars.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn verschillende attracties waaronder draaimolens, lasergame en botsauto's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are several attractions including Ferris wheels, laser game and bumper cars.

features.name: Fort Blauwkapel
features.opening: Fort Blauwkapel (ook wel: Blaucapel) is een Nederlands fort bij Utrecht.

facts.text: Construction of this fortress took place between 1818 and 1821.
facts.sourceQuote: Het fort is in 1818-1821 gebouwd als onderdeel van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie en is een van de grootste forten van de linie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fort was built in 1818-1821 as part of the New Holland Water Line and is one of the largest forts of the line.

facts.text: A new earthwork replaced the original fortification in 1818 after it fell into disrepair.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze raakte in verval, maar het bleef een strategische locatie en in 1818 werd een nieuw aardwerk aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This fell into disrepair, but it remained a strategic location and in 1818 a new earthworks was built.

facts.text: The waiting house measures 30 meters long and 20 meters wide with three vaulted rooms inside.
facts.sourceQuote: Het wachthuis is 30 meter lang en 20 meter breed. Binnen zijn drie overwelfde ruimten voor het verblijf van de manschappen en de opslag, een waterkelder en een trappenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The waiting house is 30 meters long and 20 meters wide. Inside are three vaulted rooms for the accommodation of the men and storage, a water cellar and a staircase.

facts.text: Southeast walls and canals were excavated in 1921 to make way for a new railway line.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1921 werden voor de aanleg van een nieuwe spoorlijn de wallen en gracht in het zuidoosten afgegraven en verlegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1921, the walls and canal in the southeast were excavated and relocated for the construction of a new railway line.

features.name: University Library Uithof
features.opening: De Universiteitsbibliotheek Utrecht (UB Utrecht of UBU) is de bibliotheek voor de wetenschappelijke informatievoorziening van de Universiteit Utrecht.

facts.text: The collection grew by 2,000 volumes in 1599 thanks to a legacy from canon Hubert van Buchell.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een legaat van de gewezen kanunnik Hubert van Buchell kon de stadsbibliotheek in 1599 met circa 2.000 banden worden uitgebreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a legacy from the former canon Hubert van Buchell, the city library was able to be expanded with about 2,000 volumes in 1599.

facts.text: Architect Wiel Arets designed the new Uithof building where 4.2 million books moved in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 verhuisden in totaal 4,2 miljoen boeken naar een nieuw gebouw in Utrecht Science Park, dat door architect Wiel Arets was ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, a total of 4.2 million books were moved to a new building in Utrecht Science Park, designed by architect Wiel Arets.

facts.text: The library maintains a branch in the city center alongside its main Uithof location.
facts.sourceQuote: De bibliotheek heeft zowel in de binnenstad van Utrecht als in Utrecht Science Park een vestiging, en kleinere bibliotheken bij de faculteiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The library has a branch in both the city center of Utrecht and Utrecht Science Park, and smaller libraries at the faculties.

features.name: De Gesloten Steen
features.opening: De Gesloten Steen (ook wel duivelssteen genoemd) is een zware zwerfsteen in het centrum van Utrecht.

facts.text: A ship's letter from 1520 contains the first known record of this stone under its current name.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze zwerfkei schijnt voor het eerst onder deze noemer vermeld te worden in een schepenbrief uit 1520.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This stray stone apparently appears for the first time under this heading in a ship's letter from 1520.

facts.text: The national monument is chained to a corner building at Oudegracht and Eligenhof.
facts.sourceQuote: De rijksmonumentale steen ligt vastgeketend op de hoek Oudegracht en het Eligenhof aan een hoekpand dat zijn naam eraan heeft ontleend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The national monument stone is chained to the corner of Oudegracht and the Eligenhof on a corner building that has taken its name from it.

features.name: Louis Hartloopercomplex
features.opening: Het Louis Hartlooper Complex (LHC) is een filmtheater, cultuurcentrum en horecagelegenheid in de stad Utrecht in Nederland.

facts.text: Cinema rooms were built partly underground on the courtyard to respect height limits.
facts.sourceQuote: De zalen zijn op de binnenplaats gebouwd, deels onder de grond, omdat men gebonden was aan een maximumhoogte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rooms were built on the courtyard, partly underground, because they were bound by a maximum height.

facts.text: Actor Louis Hartlooper's son officially opened the complex in September 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: De officiële opening was op 5 september 2004 door Louis Hartlooper jr., de zoon van acteur en explicateur Louis Hartlooper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The official opening was on September 5, 2004 by Louis Hartlooper Jr., the son of actor and explainer Louis Hartlooper.

facts.text: The venue officially opened its doors to the public in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater opende in 2004 zijn deuren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater opened its doors in 2004.

facts.text: Jos Stelling named the complex after Louis Hartlooper, a famous figure in Utrecht's film history.
facts.sourceQuote: Filmmaker en bioscoopeigenaar Jos Stelling nam het initiatief tot dit filmtheater dat hij vernoemde naar acteur en filmexplicateur Louis Hartlooper, een bekend persoon uit de Utrechtse filmgeschiedenis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Filmmaker and cinema owner Jos Stelling took the initiative for this film theater, which he named after actor and film explainer Louis Hartlooper, a well-known person in the Utrecht film history.

facts.text: Filmmaker and cinema owner Jos Stelling was the driving force behind creating this theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Filmmaker en bioscoopeigenaar Jos Stelling nam het initiatief tot dit filmtheater dat hij vernoemde naar acteur en filmexplicateur Louis Hartlooper, een bekend persoon uit de Utrechtse filmgeschiedenis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Filmmaker and cinema owner Jos Stelling took the initiative for this film theater, which he named after actor and film explainer Louis Hartlooper, a well-known person in the Utrecht film history.

features.name: Pathé Rembrandt Utrecht
features.opening: Pathé Rembrandt Utrecht is een bioscoop aan de Oudegracht in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: The three screening rooms accommodate a combined total of 683 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop maakt deel uit van de bioscoopketen Pathé en heeft drie zalen (het kleinste aantal van alle bioscopen van Pathé in Nederland) met in totaal 683 zitplaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema is part of the Pathé cinema chain and has three halls (the smallest number of all Pathé cinemas in the Netherlands) with a total of 683 seats.

features.name: Fort de Bilt
features.opening: Fort de Bilt, ook Fort op de Biltstraat genoemd, is een van de verdedigingswerken van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie in de gemeente Utrecht.

facts.text: In 1929-1930, a straight road and tram line were cut through the fort, dividing it into two halves.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1929-1930 werd daarom de Biltse straatweg, inclusief de dubbelsporige baan van de inmiddels elektrische tram, uiteindelijk dwars door het fort heen getrokken, waardoor het in twee helften werd gesplitst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1929-1930, the Biltse street road, including the double-track track of the now electric tram, was finally pulled straight through the fort, dividing it into two halves.

features.name: Centraal Museum
features.opening: The Centraal Museum is the main museum in Utrecht, Netherlands, founded in 1838.

facts.text: The name Centraal Museum comes from the Dutch word for central.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1921 the collection merged with various private collections in the new 'centralised museum' (hence the name 'Centraal museum', centraal being the Dutch word for central) located in the former medieval monastery at the Nicolaaskerkhof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1921 the collection merged with various private collections in the new 'centralised museum' (hence the name 'Centraal museum', centraal being the Dutch word for central) located in the former medieval monastery at the Nicolaaskerkhof.

facts.text: In 1980, the museum expanded by acquiring the collection of the Van Baaren Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1980, the museum includes the collection of the Van Baaren Museum and since 2006, the museum also runs the Miffy Museum, a museum across the street dedicated to Dick Bruna and his rabbit character Miffy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1980, the museum includes the collection of the Van Baaren Museum and since 2006, the museum also runs the Miffy Museum, a museum across the street dedicated to Dick Bruna and his rabbit character Miffy.

features.name: Theater Kikker
features.opening: Theater Kikker is een theater aan de Ganzenmarkt in de binnenstad van Utrecht.

facts.text: Founders were members of the Utrechtsch Studenten Corps in 1972.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater werd in 1972 onder de naam 'Tejater Kikker' opgericht door leden van het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater was founded in 1972 under the name 'Tejater Kikker' by members of the Utrechtsch Studenten Corps.

facts.text: The venue hosts a mix of contemporary theater and modern dance in its two rooms.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater heeft twee zalen waarin een mengeling aan eigentijds toneel en moderne dans ten uitvoering gebracht wordt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater has two rooms in which a mixture of contemporary theater and modern dance is performed.

features.name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
features.opening: De Wederkomst des Herenkerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw aan de Marco Pololaan in de wijk Kanaleneiland in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Cardinal Alfrink inaugurated the church in 1965 after construction finished.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw was voltooid in 1965 waarna de inwijding werd gedaan door kardinaal Alfrink, de toenmalige bisschop van Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction was completed in 1965 after which the inauguration was carried out by Cardinal Alfrink, the then bishop of Utrecht.

facts.text: In 2010, this parish merged with four others to form the Martinus parish.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 fuseerde de kerk met vier andere Utrechtse kerken tot de Martinusparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, the church merged with four other Utrecht churches to form the Martinus parish.

facts.text: Today, this building serves as a place of worship for the Martinus parish community.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is in gebruik bij de Martinusparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is in use by the Martinus parish.

features.name: De Vrouwenbibliotheek
features.opening: De Vrouwenbibliotheek en Documentatiecentrum Utrecht (VDU), in 1984 opgericht, was een plek waar vrouwen in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht en omgeving…

facts.text: From 1995 to 2002, the library operated within the Multicultural Emancipation Center on Wittevrouwenkade.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1995 tot 2002 maakte de Vrouwenbibliotheek deel uit van het Multicultureel Emancipatiecentrum (MEC) aan de Wittevrouwenkade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1995 to 2002, the Vrouwenbibliotheek was part of the Multicultural Emancipation Center (MEC) on the Wittevrouwenkade.

facts.text: Private individual Marjolein Datema took over the book collection in 2009 after IDEA was abolished.
facts.sourceQuote: Na stopzetting van de subsidies en opheffing van IDEA, werd de boekencollectie in 2009 overgenomen door een particulier, Marjolein Datema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the subsidies were discontinued and IDEA was abolished, the book collection was taken over in 2009 by a private individual, Marjolein Datema.

facts.text: Founders came from the women's bookstore De Heksenkelder.
