facts.sourceQuote: Op 20 oktober 1984 opende Vrouwenbibliotheek en Documentatiecentrum Utrecht (VDU) haar deuren; een initiatief van enkele vrouwen die elkaar kenden uit de vrouwenboekhandel de Heksenkelder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 20, 1984, Vrouwenbibliotheek and the Utrecht Documentation Center (VDU) opened their doors; an initiative by several women who knew each other from the women's bookstore de Heksenkelder.

facts.text: The collection expanded to 8,500 books by 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: De collectie groeide snel van ca 200 boeken bij de start naar 8.500 in 1992..
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection grew rapidly from about 200 books at the start to 8,500 in 1992..

facts.text: A 1989 move placed the library on the ground floor for street visibility.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1989 ging de bibliotheek naar de begane grond waardoor de collectie vanaf de straat zichtbaar werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1989 the library moved to the ground floor, making the collection visible from the street.

facts.text: Men were initially barred but gained access in 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: Over het toelaten van mannen werd gediscussieerd, zeker toen de VDU nog in het Vrouwenhuis zat, waar mannen niet werden toegelaten. In 1990 viel het besluit dat mannen wel in de Vrouwenbibliotheek mochten komen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There was discussion about allowing men, especially when the VDU was still in the Women's House, where men were not allowed. In 1990, it was decided that men were allowed to come into the Vrouwenbibliotheek.

features.name: Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn
features.opening: Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn is een Nederlandse bioscoop in Utrecht.

facts.text: Theater 3 became the world's 700th 4DX venue in November 2019, featuring motion, water, and wind effects during films.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2019 opende Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn de 700ste 4DX-zaal ter wereld (zaal 3). Hierbij zijn er onder andere bewegings-, water- en windeffecten aanwezig tijdens de film.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2019, Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn opened the 700th 4DX theater in the world (theater 3). Among other things, there are motion, water and wind effects present during the film.

facts.text: The cinema features seven rooms with a total capacity of 1,574 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop heeft zeven zalen (1574 zitplaatsen), waarvan de grootste ruim 284 bezoekers kan herbergen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has seven rooms (1574 seats), the largest of which can accommodate more than 284 visitors.

facts.text: Since 2017, films have been screened on the roof several times weekly during summer.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2017 wordt in de zomer een aantal keer per week op het dak een film vertoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2017, a film has been shown on the roof several times a week in the summer.

features.name: Academiegebouw
features.opening: Het Academiegebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht is het hoofdgebouw van de Universiteit Utrecht en is gelegen in een hoek van het Domplein.

facts.text: Construction finally began in 1891 after a long conflict and the death of architect Cornelis Vermeijs.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk was het gedacht als een geschenk aan de Universiteit ter gelegenheid van haar 250-jarig bestaan in 1886, maar door een slepend conflict, en het onverwacht overlijden van een van de architecten, Cornelis Vermeijs, kon de bouw pas in 1891 beginnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally it was intended as a gift to the University on the occasion of its 250th anniversary in 1886, but due to a protracted conflict, and the unexpected death of one of the architects, Cornelis Vermeijs, construction could only begin in 1891.

facts.text: Before this building existed, the university used annexes of the Domkerk from its start.
facts.sourceQuote: De universiteit van Utrecht was vanaf haar ontstaan gevestigd in enkele bijgebouwen van de Domkerk, met name in de kruisgang en de kapittelzaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The University of Utrecht was based in several annexes of the Domkerk from its inception, particularly in the transept and the chapter hall.

facts.text: A dedicated representative university building on the Domplein was only needed in the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Pas in de negentiende eeuw ontstond behoefte aan een representatief universiteitsgebouw aan het Domplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was only in the nineteenth century that there was a need for a representative university building on the Domplein.

features.name: University College Utrecht
features.opening: University College Utrecht (UCU) provides English-language Liberal Arts and Sciences undergraduate education.

facts.text: Founded in 1998, it became the first university college established anywhere in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded in 1998, as the first university college in the Netherlands, it is part of Utrecht University.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded in 1998, as the first university college in the Netherlands, it is part of Utrecht University.

facts.text: Learners construct personalized curricula drawing from over twenty disciplines across three domains.
facts.sourceQuote: Students can design their individual curriculum with courses from more than 20 disciplines in three domains: Science, Social Sciences and Humanities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students can design their individual curriculum with courses from more than 20 disciplines in three domains: Science, Social Sciences and Humanities.

facts.text: The Dining Hall building previously served as a military mess on the Kromhout Kazerne site.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dining Hall building served as a military mess on the Kromhout Kazerne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dining Hall building served as a military mess on the Kromhout Kazerne.

facts.text: The Auditorium building formerly operated as a military museum before becoming a lecture space.
facts.sourceQuote: The Auditorium building used to serve as a military museum, but is now used for larger lectures and performances.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Auditorium building used to serve as a military museum, but is now used for larger lectures and performances.

features.name: Jacobikerk
features.opening: The Jacobikerk is a landmark Protestant church in Utrecht, Netherlands.

facts.text: A cannon was installed in its tower around 1576 to fire at Vredenburg Castle.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1576-1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at Vredenburg Castle where the Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1576-1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at Vredenburg Castle where the Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.

facts.text: Protestants took over the church in 1586 and whitewashed its interior walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Around 1580 the church endured the Protestant Reformation and in 1586 it was formally handed over to the protestants, who whitewashed the wall decorations and removed the altarpieces.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1580 the church endured the Protestant Reformation and in 1586 it was formally handed over to the protestants, who whitewashed the wall decorations and removed the altarpieces.

facts.text: Pilgrims starting their Dutch journey to Santiago de Compostela traditionally begin at this church.
facts.sourceQuote: Today it is known as the starting place for Dutch pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostela along the Way of St. James.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today it is known as the starting place for Dutch pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostela along the Way of St. James.

features.name: Stadsschouwburg Utrecht
features.opening: De Stadsschouwburg is het grootste theatergebouw van de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Famous architect Willem Dudok designed the structure in 1937.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is in 1937 door de bekende architect Willem Dudok ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was designed in 1937 by the famous architect Willem Dudok.

facts.text: A gas explosion in 1880 severely damaged the roof, stage, and decorations.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1880 vond er tijdens een voorstelling een gasexplosie plaats, met grote schade aan het dak, het toneel en de decors tot gevolg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1880, during a performance, a gas explosion occurred, resulting in significant damage to the roof, the stage and the decorations.

facts.text: Maria Francisca Bia continued operating the theater after her husband died in 1875.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel het gebouw in slechte staat verkeerde en de gemeente dreigde de subsidie stop te zetten, zette mevrouw Bia na het overlijden van haar echtgenoot in 1875 de exploitatie voort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the building was in poor condition and the municipality threatened to stop the subsidy, Mrs. Bia continued to operate after the death of her husband in 1875.

features.name: Andreasklooster
features.opening: Het Andreasklooster is een voormalig klooster aan de Springweg in de Utrechtse binnenstad.

facts.text: Alfred Tepe designed the complex, which was constructed in phases between 1872 and 1886.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd in verschillende fasen gebouwd van 1872 tot 1886 en ontworpen door Alfred Tepe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in several phases from 1872 to 1886 and designed by Alfred Tepe.

facts.text: A radical renovation in 1983 demolished most of the structure while saving the facade and garden.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1983 is het complex radicaal verbouwd, het grootste deel werd gesloopt en maakte plaats voor nieuwbouw. De gevel (beschermd stadsgezicht), de gebrandschilderde ramen en de grote kloostertuin zijn bewaard gebleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1983, the complex was radically renovated, most of it was demolished and replaced by new buildings. The facade (protected cityscape), the stained glass windows and the large monastery garden have been preserved.

features.name: Geertekerk
features.opening: De Geertekerk is een kerk in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: A nun named Agnes van Zantwijck lived inside the Geertekerk walls during the 15th century.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 15de eeuw woonde binnen de muren van de Geertekerk Agnes van Zantwijck, een kluizenares.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 15th century, Agnes van Zantwijck, a nun, lived within the walls of the Geertekerk.

facts.text: Mathematician Laurens Praalder was buried within the Geertekerk on April 24, 1793.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 24 april 1793 is de Nederlandse wiskundige Laurens Praalder bijgezet in de Geertekerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 24, 1793, the Dutch mathematician Laurens Praalder was buried in the Geertekerk.

facts.text: The Geertekerk is dedicated to Saint Gertrude of Nijvel.
facts.sourceQuote: In de middeleeuwen was het een van de vier parochiekerken in die stad, en wel de kleinste en de jongste, gewijd aan de heilige Gertrudis van Nijvel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Middle Ages, it was one of the four parish churches in that city, and the smallest and youngest, dedicated to the saint Gertrude of Nijvel.

facts.text: Between 1248 and 1259, the church was moved from outside to inside the city walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste gebouw verrees op een terrein buiten de omwalling, maar tussen 1248 en 1259 werd de kerk overgebracht binnen de stadsmuren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first building was built on a site outside the walls, but between 1248 and 1259 the church was moved inside the city walls.

facts.text: In 1855, hundreds of flood victims from Veenendaal were temporarily housed within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Als gevolg van een overstroming van de Rijn werden in 1855 honderden inwoners van Veenendaal tijdelijk in de kerk ondergebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result of a flood of the Rhine, hundreds of residents of Veenendaal were temporarily accommodated in the church in 1855.

features.name: Paardenkathedraal
features.opening: De Paardenkathedraal is een theater aan de Veeartsenijstraat in de wijk Wittevrouwen in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: The name Paardenkathedraal arose from popular speech due to its neo-Gothic windows.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Paardenkathedraal ontstond in de volksmond, wegens de karakteristieke voorgevel met de neogotische ramen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Paardenkathedraal originated in popular parlance, due to the characteristic facade with the neo-Gothic windows.

features.name: Nicolaïkerk
features.opening: De Nicolaïkerk is een kerk in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht, gelegen aan het Nicolaaskerkhof 8.

facts.text: A tornado in 1674 blew a spire off the tower while damaging the nearby Domkerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Een sterke tornado in de zomer van 1674, dat o.a. het middenschip van de Domkerk deed instorten, blies een torenspits van zijn plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A strong tornado in the summer of 1674, which among other things caused the central nave of the Domkerk to collapse, blew a spire off its place.

features.name: Mobach Keramiek
features.opening: Mobach Keramiek is een aardewerkfabriek in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht die eind 19e eeuw werd opgericht.

facts.text: Founder Klaas Jaan Mobach arrived from a Frisian potter family to establish the business in 1895.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bedrijf werd in 1895 in Utrecht als de Utrechtsche Pottenfabriek opgericht door de uit een Friese pottenbakkersfamilie stammende Klaas Jaan Mobach.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The company was founded in 1895 in Utrecht as the Utrechtsche Pottenfabriek by Klaas Jaan Mobach, who came from a Frisian potter family.

facts.text: The historic factory building on Kanaalweg was constructed in 1913 and is now a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het uit 1913 daterende fabrieksgebouw aan de Kanaalweg langs het Merwedekanaal, tezamen met drie bijbehorende arbeiderswoningen, hebben de status van rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The factory building dating from 1913 on Kanaalweg along the Merwedekanaal, together with three associated worker's houses, have the status of a national monument.

facts.text: A museum at the original site opens its doors to the public only once every year.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van de collectie is op die locatie ondergebracht in een museum dat eenmaal per jaar open is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the collection is housed at that location in a museum that is open once a year.

facts.text: Workers monitored the oven's temperature by watching a melting cone bend through a small wall hole.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat bereiken van die temperatuur kon men aflezen via een gat in de ovenmuur waarachter een smeltkegel was geplaatst. Het ombuigen van die kegel gaf aan dat de temperatuur was bereikt waarop men stopte met het stoken van de oven en die liet afkoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The achievement of that temperature could be read through a hole in the oven wall behind which a melting cone had been placed. The bending of that cone indicated that the temperature had been reached at which the oven was stopped being heated and allowed to cool down.

features.name: Theologische Universiteit Utrecht
features.opening: Theological University of the Reformed Churches (Dutch: Theologische Universiteit Kampen van de Gereformeerde Kerken) is an academic theological seminary in…

facts.text: The institution began as a Theological School in 1854 before becoming a college in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1854, a Theological School (Dutch: Theologische School) was founded by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834 from the mainline Reformed Church in the Netherlands (Hervormde Kerk), to provide for education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1854, a Theological School (Dutch: Theologische School) was founded by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834 from the mainline Reformed Church in the Netherlands (Hervormde Kerk), to provide for education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939.

facts.text: Past faculty included systematic theologians Herman Bavinck and Klaas Schilder.
facts.sourceQuote: Notable faculty of the seminary in the past include systematic theologians Herman Bavinck (1854–1921) and Klaas Schilder (1890–1952), and more recently the New Testament scholar Jakob van Bruggen (born 1936).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Notable faculty of the seminary in the past include systematic theologians Herman Bavinck (1854–1921) and Klaas Schilder (1890–1952), and more recently the New Testament scholar Jakob van Bruggen (born 1936).

facts.text: Both colleges gained university status in 1986 following a Dutch system change.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1986, both colleges became universities when a change in the Dutch university/polytechnic system was carried out.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1986, both colleges became universities when a change in the Dutch university/polytechnic system was carried out.

facts.text: Stefan Paas supervises the popular Master of 21st Century Mission programme for international students.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students. Especially the MA in 21st Century Mission under the supervision of Stefan Paas is a popular programme.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students. Especially the MA in 21st Century Mission under the supervision of Stefan Paas is a popular programme.

facts.text: A full English degree called the Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology has been available since 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students.

features.name: Spoorwegmuseum
features.opening: The Railway Museum (Dutch: Het Spoorwegmuseum) in Utrecht is the Dutch national railway museum.

facts.text: Conservation of historic rail equipment began during the 1930s.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 1930s the first steps were taken to conserve old historically significant rail equipment.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1930s the first steps were taken to conserve old historically significant rail equipment.

facts.text: Some collection items were lost during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: A portion of this collection was lost during World War II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A portion of this collection was lost during World War II.

facts.text: Maliebaan station, closed since 1939, was remodeled and reopened as the museum home in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Maliebaan station, which had been closed in 1939, was found to be a suitable site. The building was remodeled, and in 1954 the museum reopened there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Maliebaan station, which had been closed in 1939, was found to be a suitable site. The building was remodeled, and in 1954 the museum reopened there.

features.name: Pieterskerk
features.opening: St. Peter's Church (Dutch: Pieterskerk) is a Reformed and former Roman Catholic church in the city of Utrecht in the Netherlands, dedicated to Peter the…

facts.text: Construction started in 1039, and the church was inaugurated on May 1, 1048.
facts.sourceQuote: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).

facts.text: The lost west towers were likely not finished until about a century after the inauguration.
facts.sourceQuote: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).

features.name: Fort aan de Klop
features.opening: Fort aan de Klop is een verdedigingswerk aan de rivier de Vecht in Utrecht.

facts.text: A European project called Crossing the Lines began in 2004 to support restoration efforts.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 startte het Europese project Crossing the Lines. Sindsdien zijn met steun van dit project het historische wachthuis en de drie houten loodsen op het fort gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, the European project Crossing the Lines began. Since then, with the support of this project, the historic guardhouse and the three wooden sheds on the fort have been restored.

facts.text: The fort officially opened to the public on July 14, 2007 after being furnished.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de inrichting van de gebouwen en het terrein werd het fort op 14 juli 2007 voor het publiek geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the buildings and grounds were furnished, the fort was opened to the public on July 14, 2007.

facts.text: Restoration work focused on a historic guardhouse and three wooden sheds.
facts.sourceQuote: Sindsdien zijn met steun van dit project het historische wachthuis en de drie houten loodsen op het fort gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since then, with the support of this project, the historic guardhouse and the three wooden sheds on the fort have been restored.

facts.text: The Waterliniepad hiking trail passes directly by this fort.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Waterliniepad komt langs dit fort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Waterliniepad passes by this fort.

facts.text: Construction of this defensive work was completed in the year 1819.
facts.sourceQuote: Het fort werd aangelegd in 1819.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fort was built in 1819.

features.name: Abraham Meijer Hamburger
features.opening: De lijst van Stolpersteine in Utrecht (gemeente) geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in de gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht zijn…

facts.text: Abraham Meijer Hamburger was a victim of the Nazi regime who is commemorated by a Stolperstein.
facts.sourceQuote: Stolpersteine zijn opgedragen aan slachtoffers van het nationaalsocialisme, al diegenen die zijn vervolgd, gedeporteerd, vermoord, gedwongen te emigreren of tot zelfmoord gedreven door het nazi-regime.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were persecuted, deported, murdered, forced to emigrate or driven to suicide by the Nazi regime.

features.name: Sint-Rafaëlkerk
features.opening: De Sint-Rafaëlkerk is een kerkgebouw van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk in de wijk Overvecht in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Architect Johannes Dresmé from Driebergen designed this church.
facts.sourceQuote: Johannes Dresmé uit Driebergen werd aangesteld als architect.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Johannes Dresmé from Driebergen was appointed as architect.

facts.text: Cardinal Alfrink consecrated the building on July 30, 1967.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 26 december 1966 werd de eerste steen gelegd aan de Lichtenberchdreef en op 30 juli 1967 werd de kerk ingewijd door kardinaal Alfrink.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 26, 1966, the first stone was laid at Lichtenberchdreef and on July 30, 1967, the church was consecrated by Cardinal Alfrink.

features.name: Sultan Ahmet
features.opening: De Noorderkerk is een monumentaal gebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: In 1978, the Pentecostal church Samuel purchased the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1978 heeft de pinkstergemeente "Samuel" het gebouw aangekocht en in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1978, the Pentecostal church "Samuel" purchased the building and took possession of it.

features.name: Domkerk
features.opening: St. Martin's Cathedral, Utrecht, or Dom Church (Dutch: Domkerk), is a Gothic church dedicated to Saint Martin of Tours, which was the cathedral of the Diocese…

facts.text: Saint Willibrord established a chapel here dedicated to Saint Martin.
facts.sourceQuote: Saint Willibrord (died 739), the Apostle to the Frisians, established a second chapel devoted to Saint Martin on (or close to) the site of the current building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Saint Willibrord (died 739), the Apostle to the Frisians, established a second chapel devoted to Saint Martin on (or close to) the site of the current building.

facts.text: A fire in 1253 destroyed the previous church, prompting Gothic construction in 1254.
facts.sourceQuote: This building, also known as Adalbold's Dom, was partially destroyed in the fire of 1253 which ravaged much of Utrecht, leading Bishop Henry van Vianen to initiate the construction of the current Gothic structure in 1254.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This building, also known as Adalbold's Dom, was partially destroyed in the fire of 1253 which ravaged much of Utrecht, leading Bishop Henry van Vianen to initiate the construction of the current Gothic structure in 1254.

facts.text: Financing dwindled after 1515, leaving the cathedral unfinished for centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: After 1515, steadily diminishing financing prevented completion of this building project, of which an almost complete series of building accounts exists.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After 1515, steadily diminishing financing prevented completion of this building project, of which an almost complete series of building accounts exists.

facts.text: A storm destroyed its nave in 1674, leaving the tower isolated from the rest of the church.
facts.sourceQuote: It was once the Netherlands' largest church, but the nave collapsed in a storm in 1674 and has never been rebuilt, leaving the tower isolated from the east end.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was once the Netherlands' largest church, but the nave collapsed in a storm in 1674 and has never been rebuilt, leaving the tower isolated from the east end.

facts.text: The single Dom Tower rises 112 metres high, serving as the city's defining landmark.
facts.sourceQuote: Unlike most of its French predecessors, the building has only one tower, the 112-metre-high (367 ft) Dom Tower, which is the hallmark of the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike most of its French predecessors, the building has only one tower, the 112-metre-high (367 ft) Dom Tower, which is the hallmark of the city.

features.name: Sara de Vries
features.opening: De lijst van Stolpersteine in Utrecht (gemeente) geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in de gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht zijn…

facts.text: The first Stolperstein in Utrecht honored Josephina Joosten-Groen, not Sara de Vries.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Stolperstein die in de stad Utrecht geplaatst is, was voor Josephina Joosten-Groen, die vrijwillig met haar man meeging naar Westerbork.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Stolperstein placed in the city of Utrecht was for Josephina Joosten-Groen, who voluntarily went with her husband to Westerbork.

facts.text: By November 2025, the municipality of Utrecht held 274 Stolpersteine.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2025 lagen in de gemeente Utrecht 274 Stolpersteine.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2025, there were 274 Stolpersteine in the municipality of Utrecht.

features.name: Exbunker
features.opening: De bunker in het Wilhelminapark is in 1943 gebouwd als bomvrije Duitse personeelsbunker in het Wilhelminapark te Utrecht.

facts.text: During the war, the park was called Nassaupark, giving this shelter the name Nassauparkbunker.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Wilhelminapark werd tijdens de oorlog Nassaupark genoemd, waarmee de bunker de naam Nassauparkbunker kreeg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the war, the Wilhelminapark was called Nassaupark, which gave the bunker the name Nassauparkbunker.

facts.text: A local rumor claims a tunnel connected the bunker to the home of Utrecht NSB mayor Van Ravenswaay.
facts.sourceQuote: Nog dichterbij, op zo'n 30 meter van de bunker, woonde de Utrechtse NSB-burgemeester Van Ravenswaay en het gerucht daarin wil dat er een tunnel bestond tussen zijn woonhuis en de bunker.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Even closer, about 30 meters from the bunker, lived the Utrecht NSB mayor Van Ravenswaay and the rumor there is that there was a tunnel between his home and the bunker.

facts.text: After the war, this structure served primarily as a physical obstacle rather than a functional building.
facts.sourceQuote: De bunker was na 1945 vooral een sta-in-de-weg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After 1945, the bunker was mainly an obstacle.

facts.text: Since 2014, visual artists have utilized the space specifically for hosting exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanwege de cultuurhistorische waarde is het sinds 2001 een gemeentelijk monument dat sinds 2014 door beeldende kunstenaars wordt gebruikt als expositieruimte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to its cultural historical value, it has been a municipal monument since 2001 and has been used as an exhibition space by visual artists since 2014.

features.name: Tuindorpkerk
features.opening: De Tuindorpkerk is een protestantse kerk op de hoek van de Professor Suringarlaan en de H.F. van Riellaan in de wijk Tuindorp in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Architect Abraham van der Kraan designed this unique structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd ontworpen door architect Abraham van der Kraan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was designed by architect Abraham van der Kraan.

facts.text: While the church is a municipal monument, its organ holds national status.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is een gemeentelijk monument, het 18e-eeuwse kerkorgel heeft de status van rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is a municipal monument, the 18th-century church organ has the status of a national monument.

facts.text: Cantor-organist Willeke Smits performed on this unique instrument for eighteen years starting in 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: De vaste bespeelster van het instrument was 2000 tot 2018 cantor-organist Willeke Smits.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The permanent performer of the instrument was cantor-organist Willeke Smits from 2000 to 2018.

facts.text: The large organ uses Kirnberger III tuning with a pitch standard of 415 Hz.
facts.sourceQuote: De dispositie van het grote orgel luidt als volgt: Koppels: HW-OP, Ped-HW, Ped-OP Tremulant Omvang manualen: C-f''' Omvang pedaal: C- d' Stemming: Kirnberger III met a'= 415 Hz
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The disposition of the large organ is as follows: Couplings: HW-OP, Ped-HW, Ped-OP Tremulant Range manuals: C-f''' Range pedal: C- d' Tuning: Kirnberger III with a'= 415 Hz

features.name: Hogeschool voor de Kunsten Utrecht
features.opening: HKU University of the Arts Utrecht (Dutch: Hogeschool voor de Kunsten Utrecht) is a performing arts and visual arts educational institution in City of Utrecht,…

facts.text: The institution officially opened its doors to students in September 1987.
facts.sourceQuote: The school opened for student enrollment in September 1987.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The school opened for student enrollment in September 1987.

features.name: De Uithof / Utrecht Science Park
features.opening: Utrecht Science Park (also known as De Uithof) is a neighbourhood in Utrecht and the largest science park in the Netherlands.

facts.text: De Uithof / Utrecht Science Park takes its name from a local farm that once stood on the land.
facts.sourceQuote: The area was named "De Uithof", after a local farm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area was named "De Uithof", after a local farm.

facts.text: The Dutch government bought this 300-hectare plot for the university in 1958.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch government purchased a plot of land of approximately 300 hectares for Utrecht University in 1958.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch government purchased a plot of land of approximately 300 hectares for Utrecht University in 1958.

facts.text: In 2018, the city council officially renamed De Uithof to Utrecht Science Park.
facts.sourceQuote: The city council decided to officially rename De Uithof to "Utrecht Science Park" in 2018.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The city council decided to officially rename De Uithof to "Utrecht Science Park" in 2018.

facts.text: Most university faculties reside here, excluding Law, Humanities, and University College Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuote: Apart from the faculties of Law, Humanities and University College Utrecht, most of the university buildings are located in Utrecht Science Park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Apart from the faculties of Law, Humanities and University College Utrecht, most of the university buildings are located in Utrecht Science Park.

features.name: Joods Monument Utrecht
features.opening: Het Joods monument in Utrecht is een gedenkteken voor de Joodse slachtoffers van de Tweede Wereldoorlog uit Utrecht.

facts.text: Reverend Wim Rietkerk led the Joods Monument Utrecht Foundation that finally brought the memorial to life.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is er gekomen dankzij de inspanningen van Stichting Joods Monument Utrecht, onder leiding van dominee Wim Rietkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument came about thanks to the efforts of the Joods Monument Utrecht Foundation, under the leadership of Reverend Wim Rietkerk.

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on October 29, 2015 by Mayor Jan van Zanen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op 29 oktober 2015 onthuld door burgemeester Jan van Zanen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was unveiled on October 29, 2015 by Mayor Jan van Zanen.

features.name: Theresia van Gelderen
features.opening: De lijst van Stolpersteine in Utrecht (gemeente) geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in de gemeente Utrecht in de Nederlandse provincie Utrecht zijn…

facts.text: By November 2025, the municipality of Utrecht held 274 such memorial stones.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2025 lagen in de gemeente Utrecht 274 Stolpersteine.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2025, there were 274 Stolpersteine in the municipality of Utrecht.

features.name: Kasteel Oudaen
features.opening: Oudaen is een versterkt middeleeuws huis (ook wel stadskasteel genoemd) aan de Oudegracht in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Dendrochronological research confirms the castle was built shortly after 1276.
facts.sourceQuote: Oudaen werd kort na het jaar 1276 gebouwd, zoals dendrochronologisch onderzoek heeft aangetoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Oudaen was built shortly after the year 1276, as dendrochronological research has shown.

facts.text: The main house's current tiled roof dates back to a reconstruction in 1894.
facts.sourceQuote: De tegenwoordige kapconstructie van het hoofdhuis dateert uit 1894; de kap is met leien gedekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current roof construction of the main house dates back to 1894; the roof is covered with tiles.

features.name: St. Jacobuskerk
features.opening: De Sint-Jacobuskerk is een kerkgebouw in de Utrechtse wijk Zuilen.

facts.text: Best Life Church held its first service here on November 5, 2017, just weeks after the Catholic closure.
facts.sourceQuote: De laatste eucharistieviering vond plaats op 12 oktober 2017. Op 5 november 2017 hield Best Life Church de eerste dienst in dit gebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The last Eucharistic celebration took place on October 12, 2017. On November 5, 2017, Best Life Church held the first service in this building.

facts.text: The St. Jacobuskerk became Zuilen's third Catholic church after Ludgerus and Salvator churches opened in 1933.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was de derde katholieke kerk in Zuilen na de Ludgeruskerk en de Salvator(nood)kerk aan de Adriaan van Bergenstraat in 1933 (nu een Koptische Kerk).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the third Catholic church in Zuilen after the Ludgerus church and the Salvator(nood) church on Adriaan van Bergenstraat in 1933 (now a Coptic Church).

features.name: Kasteel de Haar
features.opening: De Haar Castle (Dutch: Kasteel de Haar) is located outside Utrecht, Netherlands.

facts.text: The castle burned down in 1482, leaving only non-military walls intact.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1482, the castle was burned down and the walls were destroyed, except for the parts that did not have a military function.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1482, the castle was burned down and the walls were destroyed, except for the parts that did not have a military function.

facts.text: A bachelor named Anton-Martinus van Zuylen bequeathed the estate to his cousin in 1801.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1801 the last Catholic van Zuylen in the Netherlands, the bachelor Anton-Martinus van Zuylen van Nijevelt (1708–1801), bequeathed the property to his cousin Jean-Jacques van Zuylen van Nyevelt (1752–1846) of the Catholic branch in the Southern Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1801 the last Catholic van Zuylen in the Netherlands, the bachelor Anton-Martinus van Zuylen van Nijevelt (1708–1801), bequeathed the property to his cousin Jean-Jacques van Zuylen van Nyevelt (1752–1846) of the Catholic branch in the Southern Netherlands.

facts.text: The castle's massive restoration was fully funded by Baroness Hélène de Rothschild.
facts.sourceQuote: When Etienne inherited the ruined castle in 1890 from his grandfather, the couple set about rebuilding the castle, fully financed by Hélène's family.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When Etienne inherited the ruined castle in 1890 from his grandfather, the couple set about rebuilding the castle, fully financed by Hélène's family.

facts.text: Cuypers hid a statue of himself in a corner of the first-floor gallery.
facts.sourceQuote: Cuypers placed a statue of himself in a corner of the gallery on the first floor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Cuypers placed a statue of himself in a corner of the gallery on the first floor.

facts.text: Nazi attempts to seize the estate failed because steward Hendrik de Greef intervened.
facts.sourceQuote: Despite many attempts by the Nazi to seize the castle on the grounds that the owners were Jewish, the attempts failed due to actions taken by the property's steward, Hendrik de Greef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Despite many attempts by the Nazi to seize the castle on the grounds that the owners were Jewish, the attempts failed due to actions taken by the property's steward, Hendrik de Greef.

features.name: Omar-al-Faroukmoskee
features.opening: De Omar-Al-Faroukmoskee is een moskee aan de Winterboeidreef in Utrecht.

facts.text: Declining parish numbers led to the sale of the building in December 1982.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1970 liep het aantal parochianen van de kerk sterk terug, waardoor het behoud van het kerkgebouw niet meer rendabel was. Het gebouw werd in december 1982 verkocht aan de Stichting Appèl op de Islam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s, the number of parishioners of the church declined sharply, making it no longer profitable to preserve the church building. The building was sold in December 1982 to the Stichting Appèl op de Islam.

facts.text: Dutch architect Latief Perotti led the conversion of this church into a mosque.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp en uitvoering in verband met de verbouwing van kerk tot moskee stond onder leiding van de Nederlandse architect Latief Perotti.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design and execution in connection with the conversion of church into mosque was led by the Dutch architect Latief Perotti.

features.name: Kasteel Nijevelt
features.opening: Nijeveld (ook: Nijevelt, spreek uit: Nieveld of Nieuwveld) is een voormalig middeleeuws kasteel, en vanaf 1536 ridderhofstad, dat waarschijnlijk gebouwd is in…

facts.text: The noble Van Zuylen van Nijevelt family derived part of their name from this castle.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1311 gaf het kapittel van Sint-Jan 26 morgen land bij het huis te Nijevelt in pacht aan ridder Steven van Zuylen en zijn vrouw Mabelia; de oud-adellijke familie Van Zuylen van Nievelt ontleent haar naam mede aan dit goed/kasteel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1311, the chapter of St. John leased 26 acres of land near the house in Nijevelt to Sir Steven van Zuylen and his wife Mabelia; the old noble family Van Zuylen van Nievelt owes its name in part to this property/castle.

facts.text: Roman ships once sailed near the site, and an excavated example is now in a nearby museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Kasteel Nijeveld lag op de relatief hoge stroomrug van een verdwenen tak van de Rijn. Ooit voeren daar Romeinse schepen, waarvan een gaaf gebleven exemplaar is opgegraven in de directe omgeving van Nijeveld. Dit schip kan worden bekeken in het museum van het gereconstrueerde Romeinse castellum op de Hoge Woerd in De Meern.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Kasteel Nijeveld was located on the relatively high current ridge of a vanished branch of the Rhine. Roman ships once sailed there, of which a fine example has been excavated in the immediate vicinity of Nijeveld. This ship can be viewed in the museum of the reconstructed Roman castellum on the Hoge Woerd in De Meern.

facts.text: French troops destroyed the castle and its mill during a siege in 1672 or 1673.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de belegering van het kasteel door Franse troepen in 1672/1673 werden het kasteel en de molen verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the siege of the castle by French troops in 1672/1673, the castle and the mill were destroyed.

facts.text: The final brick base of the last mill vanished when demolished in 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: Uiteindelijk stond er aan de Rijksstraatweg iets ten westen van de Loobrug alleen nog de bakstenen onderbouw van deze molen. In 1971 werd ook deze laatste rest afgebroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the end, on the Rijksstraatweg a little west of the Loobrug, there was only the brick base of this mill left. In 1971, this last remnant was also demolished.

features.name: Opstandingskerk
features.opening: De Opstandingskerk is een monumentaal kerkgebouw in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht.

facts.text: Architect Anthonie de Ridder created the design for this 1957 structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is gebouwd in 1957 voor Het Apostolisch Genootschap naar een ontwerp van Anthonie de Ridder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1957 for the Apostolic Society according to a design by Anthonie de Ridder.

facts.text: A Dutch Reformed congregation now worships within these walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Momenteel is er een Nederlandse Gereformeerde kerk gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Currently, a Dutch Reformed church is established.

features.name: Anne Frank
features.opening: Het beeld van Anne Frank op het Janskerkhof in Utrecht is een standbeeld van het Duits- Joodse meisje Anne Frank dat op vijftienjarige leeftijd tijdens de…

facts.text: Utrecht sculptor Pieter d'Hont created the bronze statue.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bronzen beeld is gemaakt door de Utrechtse beeldhouwer Pieter d'Hont en werd op de verjaardag van koningin Juliana op 30 april 1959 door de Utrechtse jeugd aan de gemeente geschonken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bronze statue was made by the Utrecht sculptor Pieter d'Hont and was donated to the municipality by the Utrecht youth on the birthday of Queen Juliana on April 30, 1959.

facts.text: Local children funded the work by collecting old iron and paper.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de kinderen werd onder meer oud ijzer en papier ingezameld om het beeld te bekostigen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The children collected old iron and paper, among other things, to fund the statue.

facts.text: Anne stands with two feet on the ground while her head reaches the clouds.
facts.sourceQuote: Anne Frank wordt verbeeld met twee benen op de grond en met haar hoofd in de wolken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Anne Frank is depicted with two legs on the ground and her head in the clouds.

facts.text: Flowers are laid at the monument year-round, including by graduating students.
facts.sourceQuote: Traditioneel worden bij het standbeeld het gehele jaar bloemen neergelegd. Onder meer studenten van de studentenvereniging UVSV leggen bij het afstuderen bloemen neer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Traditionally, flowers are laid at the statue all year round. Among other things, students of the student association UVSV lay flowers when graduating.

features.name: Botanische Tuinen Universiteit Utrecht
features.opening: The Botanische garden Fort Hoofddijk in Utrecht is a botanical garden of the Botanische Tuinen of the Faculty of Science of the Universiteit Utrecht.

facts.text: The university bought the fort from the Ministry of Defense in 1963 to begin construction on a rock garden.
facts.sourceQuote: Het fort is in 1963 door de universiteit aangekocht van het ministerie van Defensie. Dat jaar werd begonnen met de aanleg van een rotstuin op het fort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fort was purchased by the university from the Ministry of Defense in 1963. That year construction began on a rock garden on the fort.

facts.text: Construction used 2100 tons of rocky material from the Ardennes, including blast furnace slag from Baarn.
facts.sourceQuote: 2100 ton rotsachtig materiaal uit de Ardennen werd hiervoor aangevoerd. Een deel van de gebruikte stenen zijn hoogoven-sintels, die kwamen uit de rotstuin van het Cantonspark in Baarn, die ook door hem en de hortulanus Muyser was aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: 2100 tons of rocky material from the Ardennes was brought in for this purpose. Some of the stones used are blast furnace slag, which came from the rock garden of the Cantonspark in Baarn, which was also laid out by him and the hortulanus Muyser.

facts.text: A computer-controlled tropical complex opened in 1987 after the collection moved from Sandwijck greenhouses.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1987 werd een computergestuurd tropisch kassencomplex geopend. Naar dit complex verhuisde de botanische collectie uit de kassen van landgoed 'Sandwijck' dat toen zijn functie als botanische kas verloor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1987, a computer-controlled tropical concession stand complex was opened. The botanical collection moved from the greenhouses of the 'Sandwijck' estate, which then lost its function as a botanical greenhouse, to this complex.

facts.text: The garden covers 8 hectares on and around Fort Hoofddijk.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin is gevestigd op en rondom Fort Hoofddijk en herbergt de levende plantencollectie van de universiteit. De tuin ligt aan de rand van het universiteitscomplex Utrecht Science Park (voorheen 'De Uithof') en beslaat een oppervlakte van 8 hectare.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden is located on and around Fort Hoofddijk and houses the university's living plant collection. The garden is located on the edge of the Utrecht Science Park university complex (formerly 'De Uithof') and covers an area of 8 hectares.

facts.text: By mid-2007, the living plant collection held over six thousand species.
facts.sourceQuote: Halverwege 2007 telde de collectie ruim zesduizend plantensoorten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By mid-2007, the collection numbered more than six thousand plant species.

features.name: Park Transwijk
features.opening: Park Transwijk is a city park in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Visitors can find a children's farm within the park grounds today.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park bevindt zich onder meer een kinderboerderij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park includes a children's farm, among other things.

facts.text: A Traffic Garden here taught local children road safety from 1963 until closing in 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1963 tot de sluiting in 2015 kregen kinderen uit de regio in de Verkeerstuin van het park les in verkeerssituaties.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1963 until its closure in 2015, children from the region received traffic situation lessons in the Traffic Garden of the park.

features.name: Park Nieuweroord
features.opening: Park Nieuweroord is a park in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: In 1918, the original country house was replaced by the colossal railway building De Inktpot.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1918 dienden de buitenplaats en het park vrijwel geheel plaats te maken voor De Inktpot, een kolossaal nieuw hoofdgebouw voor de Nederlandse Spoorwegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1918, the country house and the park were almost completely replaced by De Inktpot, a colossal new main building for the Dutch Railways.

features.name: Amaliapark
features.opening: The Amaliapark is located in the Utrecht district of Leidsche Rijn.

facts.text: Amaliapark gained national monument status in 2010 after years of existence.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park heeft sinds 2010 de status van rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park has been a national monument since 2010.

features.name: Amelisweerd
features.opening: Amelisweerd is a estate in the municipality of Bunnik, east of the city of Utrecht.

facts.text: The estate later split into three parts, creating today's Oud-Amelisweerd and Nieuw-Amelisweerd.
facts.sourceQuote: Later werd het landgoed in drieën gedeeld. Twee delen vormen het huidige Oud-Amelisweerd; het derde deel vormt Nieuw-Amelisweerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later the estate was divided into three parts. Two parts form the current Oud-Amelisweerd; the third part forms Nieuw-Amelisweerd.

facts.text: Several hiking routes wind through the estate grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Er lopen verschillende wandelroutes door Amelisweerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are several hiking routes through Amelisweerd.

features.name: Julianapark
features.opening: The Julianapark is a city park near Julianapark and the surrounding area in the Northwest district of Utrecht.

facts.text: Banker Jan Kol originally commissioned Louis Copijn to design this English garden for him.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zuidelijke gedeelte van het park werd in 1903 als Engelse tuin ontworpen door de park- en landschapsarchitect Louis Copijn (1878 - 1945) in opdracht van de bankier Jan Kol, eigenaar van de bank Vlaer en Kol.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The southern part of the park was designed in 1903 as an English garden by the park and landscape architect Louis Copijn (1878 - 1945) on behalf of the banker Jan Kol, owner of the bank Vlaer and Kol.

facts.text: A major expansion in 1935 gave the park its current form under architect Krijn Perk Flanders.
facts.sourceQuote: In het kader van de werkverschaffing vond in 1935 een grote uitbreiding plaats onder verantwoordelijkheid van tuinarchitect Krijn Perk Vlaanderen en kreeg het de huidige vorm en naam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As part of the work relief, a major expansion took place in 1935 under the responsibility of garden architect Krijn Perk Flanders and it took its current form and name.

features.name: De Groene Kop
features.opening: Park De Groene Kop is a park on the north side of Tuindorp Oost, a neighborhood in the Noordoost district in Utrecht.

facts.text: A walking path honors Hans Lubach, a resident who worked for years on the park's redesign.
facts.sourceQuote: Hierbij werd ook het nieuwe wandelpad in gebruik genomen, dat genoemd is naar Hans Lubach (1935-2015), die zich als buurtbewoner jarenlang heeft ingezet voor de herinrichting van het park en de aanleg van het wandelpad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new walking path, named after Hans Lubach (1935-2015), who for many years as a neighborhood resident worked for the redesign of the park and the construction of the walking path, was also put into use here.

facts.text: Beyond recreation, the three-hectare park functions as a water retention area for the northeast.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park, dat ruim 3 hectaren groot is, dient tevens als wateropvang in Noordoost.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park, which is over 3 hectares large, also serves as a water retention area in the northeast.

features.name: Buitenplaats Sandwijck
features.opening: The Sandwijck estate is located south of De Bilt, Utrechtseweg nr.

facts.text: A villa replaced the original farm in 1770, featuring an English landscape park.
facts.sourceQuote: Door haar werd in 1770 opdracht gegeven de boerderij te vervangen door een buitenhuis. Ook het park werd aangelegd in de Engelse landschapsstijl.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1770, she commissioned the replacement of the farm with a villa. The park was also laid out in the English landscape style.

facts.text: Adriana Voet van Winssen commissioned the villa's construction after inheriting the estate in 1759.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze kwam uiteindelijk door vererving in het bezit van Adriana Voet van Winssen in 1759. Door haar werd in 1770 opdracht gegeven de boerderij te vervangen door een buitenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This eventually came into the possession of Adriana Voet van Winssen by inheritance in 1759. In 1770, she commissioned the replacement of the farm with a villa.

features.name: Park de Watertoren
features.opening: Park de Watertoren is a large park in the Overvecht district in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Two paths named Marnedreef and Moezeldreef cross through the green space.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park wordt doorsneden door de Marnedreef en de Moezeldreef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is crossed by the Marnedreef and the Moezeldreef.

facts.text: Water dominates the layout with a central canal called the Singel and features in peatland meadows.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit komt onder meer tot uitdrukking in de centraal gelegen hoofdwatergang de Singel en de diverse sloten in het veenweidegebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is expressed, among other things, in the centrally located main waterway the Singel and the various canals in the peatland meadow area.

facts.text: Children can play in a dedicated splash pool alongside several ponds and water features.
facts.sourceQuote: Verder is er een spetterbadje voor kinderen en zijn er verschillende vijvers en waterpartijen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a splash pool for children and there are several ponds and water features.

features.name: Majellapark
features.opening: The Majellapark is a public park in the West district of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Majellapark honors Gerardus Majella, an 18th-century Italian saint who was canonized.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park en de straat zijn geheten naar Gerardus Majella, een 18e-eeuwse Italiaan die is heilig verklaard.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park and the street are named after Gerardus Majella, an 18th-century Italian who was canonized.

facts.text: A 1938 fountain sculpture of a dancing girl by Suzanne Nicolas-Nijs once stood in the park's water basin.
facts.sourceQuote: Niet meer aanwezig is de in 1938 aangelegde waterbassin met een fonteinkunstwerk in de vorm van een dansend meisje gemaakt door Suzanne Nicolas-Nijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: No longer present is the water basin built in 1938 with a fountain sculpture in the shape of a dancing girl made by Suzanne Nicolas-Nijs.

features.name: Moreelsepark
features.opening: The Moreelsepark is a park with a corresponding street in the city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Municipal authorities purchased the site in 1901 to establish it as a public park.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de bouw van Hoofdgebouw II in 1894 werd dit plantsoen aanzienlijk uitgebreid, en in 1901 kocht de gemeente het en maakte er een openbaar park van.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the construction of Main Building II in 1894, this park was significantly expanded, and in 1901 the municipality bought it and turned it into a public park.

facts.text: An annual theater festival called De Parade is hosted within these grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Moreelsepark is jaarlijks het toneel van theaterfestival De Parade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Moreelsepark is the venue of the annual theater festival De Parade.

features.name: Rosarium
features.opening: The Rosarium Oudwijk in the Dutch city of Utrecht is a rose garden near Wilhelminapark and the surrounding area on the east side of the city.

facts.text: The association handed the site to the municipality on June 7, 1913 but kept maintenance until 1938.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 7 juni 1913 werd het rosarium door de vereniging aan de gemeente overgedragen, maar bleef in onderhoud bij de vereniging tot 1938.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On June 7, 1913, the rosary was handed over to the municipality by the association, but remained in maintenance by the association until 1938.

features.name: Griftpark
features.opening: The Griftpark is a park in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located in the Noordoost district on the streets Blauwkapelseweg and Kleine Singel.

facts.text: Soil rehabilitation took place between 1993 and 2002 before landscaping resumed.
facts.sourceQuote: Uiteindelijk werd tussen 1993 en 2002 de bodem in het gebied gesaneerd, waarna het opnieuw werd ingericht als stadspark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Finally, between 1993 and 2002, the soil in the area was rehabilitated, after which it was again landscaped as a city park.

features.name: Máximapark
features.opening: The Máximapark is a city park, located in the west of the Dutch municipality of Utrecht.

facts.text: Originally named Leidsche Rijn Park, it was renamed Máximapark in 2011 to honor Princess Máxima.
facts.sourceQuote: Aanvankelijk heette dit park het Leidsche Rijn Park. Op 17 mei 2011 kreeg het park zijn nieuwe naam ter ere van de veertigste verjaardag van toen nog prinses Máxima.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, this park was called the Leidsche Rijn Park. On May 17, 2011, the park received its new name in honor of the fortieth anniversary of then Princess Máxima.

facts.text: Despite its name, the Vlinderhof garden was not designed to attract butterflies.
facts.sourceQuote: Anders dan de naam suggereert, is de Vlinderhof geen vlindertuin omdat de planten in het ontwerp niet primair zijn geselecteerd op hun aantrekkelijkheid voor insecten maar op hun esthetische en stilistische waarde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Contrary to the name suggests, the Vlinderhof is not a butterfly garden because the plants in the design were not primarily selected for their attractiveness to insects but for their aesthetic and stylistic value.

facts.text: A neighborhood resident initiated the garden's creation in 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin is in 2014 ontstaan op initiatief van een buurtbewoner en is aangelegd en wordt onderhouden door vrijwilligers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden was created in 2014 at the initiative of a neighborhood resident and is landscaped and maintained by volunteers.

facts.text: Piet Oudolf designed the permanent plant garden for aesthetic value rather than insect attraction.
facts.sourceQuote: Verscholen in het park ligt de Vlinderhof, een vaste-plantentuin ontworpen door Piet Oudolf. Anders dan de naam suggereert, is de Vlinderhof geen vlindertuin omdat de planten in het ontwerp niet primair zijn geselecteerd op hun aantrekkelijkheid voor insecten maar op hun esthetische en stilistische waarde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hidden in the park is the Vlinderhof, a permanent plant garden designed by Piet Oudolf. Contrary to the name suggests, the Vlinderhof is not a butterfly garden because the plants in the design were not primarily selected for their attractiveness to insects but for their aesthetic and stylistic value.

features.name: Lepelenburg
features.opening: Lepelenburg is part of Zocherpark in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Six houses for poor widows were founded in 1621 on the grounds of Klein Lepelenburg.
facts.sourceQuote: Zes van de in totaal vijftien vrijwoningen van de Bruntskameren ten behoeve van arme weduwen werden in 1621 gesticht door de advocaat Frederik Brunt op het erf van zijn huis Klein Lepelenburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Six of the total fifteen free houses of the Bruntskameren for the benefit of poor widows were founded in 1621 by the lawyer Frederik Brunt on the grounds of his house Klein Lepelenburg.

facts.text: The Kol banking family lived there for a century as the city's largest private residence.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was gedurende een eeuw het woonhuis van de bankiersfamilie Kol (geslacht) en het grootste particulier bewoonde huis van de stad Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For a century it was the residence of the Kol (surname) banking family and the largest privately inhabited house in the city of Utrecht.

facts.text: An earthen fortification built in the 16th century became part of the park around 1860.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast verrees in de 16e eeuw een aarden bolwerk dat diende in de Utrechtse stadsverdediging, maar omstreeks 1860 werd omgevormd tot onderdeel van het huidige singelplantsoen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, an earthen fortification was built in the 16th century that served in the Utrecht city defense, but around 1860 it was transformed into part of the current singel park.

features.name: Natuurpark Bloeyendael
features.opening: Natuurpark Bloeyendael is a park and former estate in the Utrecht neighborhood of Rijnsweerd in the Oost district.

facts.text: The original house vanished under asphalt when the Biltse Streetway was widened in 1936.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij verbreding van de Biltse Straatweg in 1936 verdween de plaats van het huis onder het asfalt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Biltse Streetway was widened in 1936, the location of the house disappeared under the asphalt.

facts.text: Before becoming Bloeyendael, this area was known as Biesfelt and once housed an inn called De Grote Biesbosch.
facts.sourceQuote: De buitenplaats is tussen 1628 en 1660 ontstaan door verbouwing van de herberg 'De Grote Biesbosch'. Het gebied werd indertijd Biesfelt genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden was created between 1628 and 1660 by the renovation of the inn 'De Grote Biesbosch'. The area was then called Biesfelt.

features.name: Wilhelminapark
features.opening: The Wilhelminapark is a city park in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Wilhelminapark was renamed in 1898 to honor Queen Wilhelmina's inauguration.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd in 1898 officieel geopend en toen omgedoopt tot Wilhelminapark ter ere van Wilhelmina die in datzelfde jaar was ingehuldigd als koningin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was officially opened in 1898 and then renamed Wilhelminapark in honor of Wilhelmina who had been inaugurated as queen that same year.

facts.text: During World War II, the park temporarily bore the name Nassaupark.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog kreeg het park tijdelijk de naam Nassaupark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, the park was temporarily renamed Nassaupark.

facts.text: Baron van Boetzelaer sold his land only if a public walking park was built alongside homes.
facts.sourceQuote: De eigenaar, baron van Boetzelaer van Oosterhout, vroeg veel minder geld dan zijn noordelijke buurman, maar stelde wel een aanvullende voorwaarde: er moesten niet alleen woonhuizen komen, maar ook een openbaar wandelpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The owner, Baron van Boetzelaer van Oosterhout, asked for much less money than his northern neighbor, but did put forward an additional condition: not only residential houses but also a public walking park were to be built.

facts.text: Wilhelminapark holds the distinction of being one of the first parks established in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is als een van de eerste parken in Nederland erkend als rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is recognized as a national monument as one of the first parks in the Netherlands.

features.name: Voorveldse Polder
features.opening: Park de Voorveldse Polder is a park on the northeastern edge of the city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Fort De Bilt, a defensive work of the New Holland Water Line, stands inside the park.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park ligt Fort De Bilt, een van de verdedigingswerken van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park is Fort De Bilt, one of the defensive works of the New Holland Water Line.

features.name: Vredenburgplein
features.opening: The Vredenburg, also known as Vreeburg, is a busy square in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Witch trials were held on this square in the year 1595.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1595 vonden er heksenverbrandingen plaats op het Vredenburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1595, witch trials took place on the Vredenburg.

facts.text: A gas factory operated here from 1842 until 1862.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het Vredenbrug stond vanaf 1842 een gasfabriek, tot in 1862 de Gemeentelijke Gasfabriek in gebruik werd genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A gas factory stood on the Vredenbrug from 1842, until the Municipal Gas Factory was put into use in 1862.

facts.text: Trijn van Leemput famously signaled the demolition of the castle to a crowd of women on May 2, 1577.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens de overlevering zou Trijn van Leemput op 2 mei 1577 na het beleg van Vredenburg een grote groep vrouwen hebben verzameld en zijn opgetrokken naar het kasteel Vredenburg, waar ze het signaal gaf om het kasteel te slopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to tradition, Trijn van Leemput gathered a large group of women on May 2, 1577, after the siege of Vredenburg, and marched to the castle of Vredenburg, where she gave the signal to demolish the castle.

features.name: Janskerkhof
features.opening: The Janskerkhof is a square in Utrecht, the capital of the Dutch province of Utrecht.

facts.text: In 2000, dozens of buried bodies and sarcophagi were discovered when a busway was built.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de aanleg van de HOV-busbaan, in 2000, werden vele tientallen begravenen aangetroffen die dateren uit de tijd dat dit nog een immuniteit was. Onder meer kwamen sarcofagen en begraven vrouwen aan het licht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the HOV busway was built, in 2000, many dozens of buried bodies were found that date back to the time when this was still an immunity. Among other things, sarcophagi and buried women came to light.

facts.text: Every Saturday, the square transforms into a large flower and plant market.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plein is iedere zaterdag een grote bloemen- en plantenmarkt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Every Saturday there is a large flower and plant market on the square.

facts.text: The PhRM society of the Utrecht Student Corps maintains its base on this square.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de sociëteit PhRM van het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps ligt aan dit plein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The PhRM society of the Utrecht Student Corps is also located on this square.

features.name: Domplein
features.opening: The Domplein is a square in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: A square first emerged here only after the Sint-Salvatorkerk was demolished following the Reformation.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de Hervorming werd de Sint-Salvatorkerk afgebroken zodat er voor het eerst een plein ontstond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Reformation, the Sint-Salvatorkerk was demolished so that for the first time a square was created.

facts.text: A statue of Count Jan van Nassau, who initiated the Union of Utrecht, stands before the Academy Building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het standbeeld van graaf Jan van Nassau, initiatiefnemer van de Unie van Utrecht, staat voor het Academiegebouw en werd in 1883 onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue of Count Jan van Nassau, initiator of the Union of Utrecht, stands in front of the Academy Building and was unveiled in 1883.

facts.text: The copper sphere monument Sol represents a billionth part of the sun and was created in 1993.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen dit beeld en het academiegebouw ligt het monument "Sol", een koperen bol die een miljardste deel van de zon voorstelt en in 1993 werd gemaakt door Inez de Heer Kloots en Theo van der Hoeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between this image and the academy building is the monument "Sol", a copper sphere representing a billionth part of the sun and created in 1993 by Inez de Heer Kloots and Theo van der Hoeven.

facts.text: A resistance monument unveiled in 1949 marks the site where the central ship of the Dom once stood.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de plaats van het verdwenen middenschip van de Dom staat een groot verzetsmonument uit 1949, gemaakt door Corinne Franzén-Heslenfeld met een gedicht van Jan Engelman, waar jaarlijks de Dodenherdenking op 4 mei wordt gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the site of the missing central ship of the Dom stands a large resistance monument from 1949, made by Corinne Franzén-Heslenfeld with a poem by Jan Engelman, where the Remembrance Day is held annually on May 4.

features.name: Neude
features.opening: The Neude is a square in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Witch trials were held on this square around the year 1533.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1533 vonden er heksenverbrandingen plaats op de Neude.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1533, witch trials took place on the Neude.

facts.text: A single Lutheran heretic was burned at the stake here in the sixteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Een enkele lutherse "ketter" eindigde in die eeuw ook op de Neude op de brandstapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A single Lutheran "heretic" also ended up on the Neude on the stake in that century.

facts.text: The name Neude derives from 'Node', describing the swampy depression that once defined the site.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Neude komt van "Node", moerassige laagte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Neude comes from "Node", swampy depression.

features.name: Lapjesmarkt
features.opening: The Lapjesmarkt in Utrecht is a textile and stationery market.

facts.text: Municipal permission for a linen market was granted on May 5, 1597.
facts.sourceQuote: De Utrechtse lapjesmarkt in de Breedstraat wordt al in de 16e eeuw genoemd en op 5 mei 1597 gaf de gemeente toestemming aan het linnenweversgilde om hier twee keer per jaar een linnenmarkt te houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Utrecht patchwork market in the Breedstraat is mentioned as early as the 16th century and on May 5, 1597, the municipality gave permission to the linen weavers' guild to hold a linen market here twice a year.

facts.text: The market likely ceased operations during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 17e en 18e eeuw was er hoogstwaarschijnlijk geen markt meer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 17th and 18th centuries, there was probably no market anymore.

features.name: Stadionlaan
features.opening: The Stadionlaan is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Stadionlaan and its famous flat take their name from the nearby Stadion Galgenwaard.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat en de flat zijn vernoemd naar het ernaast gelegen Stadion Galgenwaard.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street and the apartment building are named after the nearby Stadion Galgenwaard.

facts.text: A viaduct for Rijksweg 22 was constructed over this street in 1938.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1938 werd het viaduct in Rijksweg 22 aangelegd over de Stadionlaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1938, the viaduct in Rijksweg 22 was built over the Stadionlaan.

features.name: Loevenhoutsedijk
features.opening: The Rode bridge (also known as Rodebrug, Rode Brug, Roode Brug, "Rooie Brug" or Hogelandse Brug) is a bridge over the Vecht River in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Police officers from a nearby station had to intervene when cars could not pass on this narrow structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de smalle brug konden twee auto’s elkaar niet passeren, waarbij nogal eens gevaarlijke verkeerssituaties ontstonden. In zulke gevallen moest de politie uit de aan de Hogelanden gevestigde politiepost ingrijpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the narrow bridge, two cars could not pass each other, which often created dangerous traffic situations. In such cases, the police had to intervene from the police station located in the Hogelanden.

facts.text: Summer heat once caused the bridge to get stuck, leading to water spraying on the deck for cooling around 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer kon de brug door uitzetting vast komen te zitten en daarom werd de brug sinds ongeveer het jaar 2000 's zomers overdag gekoeld door water op het brugdek te spuiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer, the bridge could get stuck due to expansion, so since around the year 2000, the bridge has been cooled during the day in the summer by spraying water on the bridge deck.

features.name: Jan van Scorelstraat
features.opening: The Jan van Scorelstraat is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Adriaen van Ostadelaan to the Rembrandtkade and Stadhoudersbrug, after…

facts.text: A 1923 facade decoration by Amsterdam sculptor Hildo Krop adorns a WBV residential complex here.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan een van de gevels van een woningcomplex van de woningbouwvereniging WBV in de Jan van Scorelstraat prijkt een gevelversiering uit 1923 van Hildo Krop die grote bekendheid kreeg als stadsbeeldhouwer van Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On one of the facades of a residential complex of the housing association WBV in the Jan van Scorelstraat, there is a facade decoration from 1923 by Hildo Krop that gained great fame as a city sculptor of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The long-established café Jan Primus operates within the buildings numbered 27 to 31 on this street.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Jan van Scorelstraat 27-31 bevindt zich het in Utrecht van oudsher bekende café Jan Primus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Jan van Scorelstraat 27-31 houses the long-established Utrecht café Jan Primus.

facts.text: A former Sint Antonius Hospital on this route became an apartment complex in 1984.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de Jan van Scorelstraat/hoek Rembrandtkade bevindt zich revalidatiecentrum De Hoogstraat. alsook het voormalige Sint Antonius Ziekenhuis dat in 1984 is verbouwd tot appartementencomplex.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the Jan van Scorelstraat/corner Rembrandtkade is the rehabilitation center De Hoogstraat. as well as the former Sint Antonius Hospital that was converted into an apartment complex in 1984.

facts.text: Forty-six buildings along the street are designated as municipal monuments.
facts.sourceQuote: Er staan 46 gemeentelijke monumenten in de Jan van Scorelstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are 46 municipal monuments in the Jan van Scorelstraat.

features.name: A.B.C.-straat
features.opening: The A.B.C.-straat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: The southern section was demolished around 1965 to expand a children's hospital.
facts.sourceQuote: De bebouwing van het zuidelijk deel werd rond 1965 gesloopt ten behoeve van uitbreiding van het Wilhelmina Kinderziekenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of the southern part was demolished around 1965 for the purpose of expanding the Wilhelmina Children's Hospital.

features.name: Oudkerkhof
features.opening: The Oudkerkhof is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, running from the Stadhuisbrug in the west to the Domstraat in the east.

facts.text: A display case at number 15 was designed by the famous architect Gerrit Rietveld.
facts.sourceQuote: De etalage op nummer 15 is een ontwerp van Gerrit Rietveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The display case at number 15 is a design by Gerrit Rietveld.

features.name: Achter de Dom
features.opening: Achter de Dom is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Paving stones here reveal the hidden outlines of the Roman fort Traiectum and medieval castle Trecht.
facts.sourceQuote: In de bestrating van Achter de Dom zijn de contouren zichtbaar gemaakt van het Romeinse fort Traiectum, in de middeleeuwen de burcht Trecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the paving of Achter de Dom, the contours of the Roman fort Traiectum, in the Middle Ages the castle Trecht, have been made visible.

facts.text: A famous modern art museum led by Wouter Kotte operated on this street from 1964 to 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: In deze straat bevond zich van 1964 tot 1990 Museum Hedendaagse Kunst-Utrecht, dat geleid werd onder Wouter Kotte en tot ver buiten de stadsgrenzen bekendheid verwierf.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1964 to 1990, Museum Hedendaagse Kunst-Utrecht was located on this street, which was led by Wouter Kotte and gained fame far beyond the city limits.

features.name: Breedstraat
features.opening: The Breedstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Trees and parked cars in the center make the street appear narrower than its actual width.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de bomen en geparkeerde auto's midden in de straat oogt de straat smaller dan het werkelijk is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the trees and parked cars in the middle of the street, the street looks narrower than it actually is.

facts.text: The former J. van Boekhoven printing press on this site was converted into residential units in 1975.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook stond deze straat bekend vanwege Drukkerij J. van Boekhoven die hier jaren gevestigd is geweest (deze is in 1975 verbouwd tot wooneenheden).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This street was also known for Drukkerij J. van Boekhoven, which has been located here for many years (this was converted into residential units in 1975).

features.name: Abstederbrug
features.opening: The Abstederbrug is a national monument bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: Abstederbrug takes its name from the historic Abstede estate located just outside the moat.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de brug verwijst naar het buitengrachtse Abstede.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the bridge refers to the Abstede outside the moat.

features.name: Achter Sint Pieter
features.opening: The Achter St.-Pieter, also known as Achter Sint Pieter, is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht, located west of the Sint-Pieter (Pieterskerk).

facts.text: Several canon houses were located along Achter Sint Pieter before they disappeared.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat telde vroeger diverse kanunnikenhuizen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street used to have several canon houses.

facts.text: The house features a straight cornice and brick arches made of natural stone blocks.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit woonhuis uit de 17e eeuw met een rechte kroonlijst en met natuurstenen blokken gemetselde bogen staat als rijksmonument geregistreerd onder nummer 35984.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This 17th century house with a straight cornice and brick arches made of natural stone blocks is registered as a national monument under number 35984.

features.name: Sint-Jacobsstraat
features.opening: The Monicabrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht.

facts.text: The current Monicabrug crossing the street has a clearance height of approximately 2.75 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is gebouwd naar ontwerp van de Nederlandse architect Wiek Röling en werd geopend in 2001.Ze kent een doorvaarthoogte van circa 2,75 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge was built to the design of the Dutch architect Wiek Röling and was opened in 2001. It has a clearance height of approximately 2.75 meters.
